I want to introduce this article on Spiritual Gifts by observing an interesting verse: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men –Ephesians 4:8. Throughout history, when a king went to battle against a city and conquered it, he and his army returned home, to be greeted by their people with great fanfare. They would march through the city with all the spoils of war, after which the king would hand out gifts from the stuff that was taken in battle, giving it to his people.

Likewise, when Jesus was crucified, through His death and resurrection, He conquered the enemy. He took the power from death, hell, the grave and from Satan himself for those who repent and believe in Him. When He returned home (ascended up on high) He gave gifts to His people— the Church. Here in Ephesians, we have a condensed list of spiritual gifts: And he [God] gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers –Ephesians 4:11.

We observe more detailed descriptions of these gifts given to the Church in 1 Corinthians chapter 12 both at the beginning of the chapter and the end of the chapter and in Romans chapter 12 verses 6 to 8. In 1 Corinthians we see the following gifts given—the word of wisdom, the word of knowledge, faith, healing, miracles, tongues, discerning of tongues, helps, and governments. Then, in Romans, we have more gifts added to our list—ministry, exhortation, giving, ruling, and showing mercy.

If I did not miss any, there is a total of 19 gifts given to the church. What a wealth of gifts have been given to the church when Jesus ascended up on high! It would be good for us to do a thorough study on each one of these gifts so that we would be able to recognize them in our congregations. One thing that could be observed is that our Pentecostal friends have taken a select few of these gifts such as miracles, healing, and speaking in tongues, and have held them above the rest, making them a validation of whether a person is born again, baptized in the Holy Spirit, or if they are more spiritual than those lacking these gifts. Or we could consider how the evangelicals tend to do the same with the gift of evangelism, which has made inroads into many conservative Anabaptist churches. Finally, we might examine how some of us plain churches take only the gifts that have to do with Church government, leaving it only to those who are ordained to have gifts, while most all the rest of the gifts are left unrecognized.

This all leads me to ask the question, “Should we be lifting one or two gifts out above the rest and emphasizing them, or should all of the gifts be recognized equally?” The only time that I see one lifted above the rest is in Paul’s letter to the Corinthians in the last verse of Chapter 12, and the first verse in chapter 14, where he exhorts them to covet after the best gift which, with careful reading, we will notice is referring to prophesy. As we continue with our careful reading, we discover that prophecy should hold precedence over speaking in tongues since apparently the Corinthian understanding of speaking in tongues was being abused and misused and the Church might not have been edified by their behavior.

Spiritual Gifts Should Not Excuse Ungodly Behavior

A word of caution might be in order here. There is an emphasis by some, on “knowing what my spiritual gift is.” I think this can be good, but it should not be done to the fault of excusing myself for bad behavior because “I have this gift and not the other.” For example, the prophet might excuse himself for being harsh because his gift is that of a prophet; since he may not have the gift of mercy, people may be unnecessarily hurt. We will all probably have a primary gift or gifts. As much as we may try to be well-equipped with as many of the gifts as we can, some will still be more dominant than others.

I have asked numerous people which gift was primary in the life of our Lord Jesus and the short answer is that He was full of the Holy Ghost and without measure and had them all. True enough, but even so, since we all want to be like Jesus, maybe we should stop excusing ourselves to one limited gift and pursue to be as fully equipped as possible. I know, and you know, that in this flesh we will not master them all and yet we should be receptive to them all. Having said that, we must realize, we are meant to be interdependent; that is why Jesus handed out these gifts severally to each man and we will all have our primary gift or gifts. But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will –1 Corinthians 12:11. Nevertheless, let’s be careful that we do not excuse wrong behavior, or, on the other hand, negligence of doing good, because “Well, that is just not my gift”.

Spiritual Gifts Are Not The Christian’s Identity

A couple of cautions may also be in place when seeking to understand spiritual gifts. Our identity should not be the gift that we have but rather that our identity is in Christ. We are a child of the King; we are not primarily a prophet, a teacher, or an evangelist. However, in being a child of the King, we have been given a gift by Him, to do His work, with His power. Recognizing first and foremost who we are in Christ will keep us in a beautiful place of humility, but if our primary identity is “this gift that I have,” I suppose it would be hard not to fall into pride and thus we open ourselves up to many pitfalls and dangers.

Spiritual Gifts Are God-Given, Not To Be Sought After By Man

Could there be a caution given in how we seek this gift? What does it mean when the Scripture says that God gives gifts according to His choosing? For instance, God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will? –Hebrews 2:4. Or, But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will –1 Corinthians 12:11.

Do you notice in both verses the WILL of God being very involved in the giving of gifts in the Church? Maybe our “seeking spiritual gifts” should be done alone in our closet, asking God to make me humble and endue me with whatever gift He wants me to have to make me a useful tool in the church body that I am a part of—“Not my will, but thine be done”. Maybe He has given me a gift that I am not recognizing or using, and what I actually need is to stir up that gift and not neglect it, but rather use it in the place I fill in the church. Could it be possible that, if I were to seek enough after another spiritual gift, I just might get myself a counterfeit?

Also, it would be good to mention very directly again that when there is a focused seeking after spiritual gifts usually there is some resulting negative problem. Sometimes a select few are lifted out and taught to be more spiritually important, such as speaking in tongues, miracles, and healing. Some will promote that there is little to no value in the teaching of spiritual gifts and that the only ones which are for our day are the ones pertaining to the ordained church leaders such as government, pastors, and teachers. While some people use their understanding of spiritual gifts to become individualistic and they see little value in being a part of a body. This is wrong, since a careful reading of these Scriptures show us that ALL the gifts are essential so that God will have the ability to make use of all the gifts by a collaboration of all the people. Could it be possible that where certain gifts are elevated above the rest, whether it is speaking in tongues, healings, and miracles; or if it is evangelism; or if it is those more suited for the ordained among us, that there could be an unrecognized element of pride in our midst? We are so prone to disillusionment that it would be good to check our hearts thoroughly when seeking after spiritual gifts.

Spiritual Gifts Are Not Included In The Biblical List of Qualifications For Church Leaders

Paul told Timothy, Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery –1 Timothy 4:14. Maybe rather than seeking out a gift, we need to stop neglecting the gift that has been given to us. Rather than seeking something new and exciting, we should stir up the gift we do have. It has happened that men in leadership have been removed from their post, because they do not have the gift for that which they were ordained. I would be very slow and very prayerful before removing an ordained brother from his office for that reason. Would it not be better to pray that God would increase that gift that had been given him by the laying on of hands? To quickly conclude that he does not have the gift may just be the easy way out.

We would never do that in a marriage. How often has it happened that a wife was more gifted in leadership than her husband? Disannulling the marriage is not an option, nor is it an option to add a third person to the marriage union to bring balance to the perceived lack of a proper balance of gifting. We have often seen that when prayer and the Holy Ghost was involved in a situation like this, God gave the husband what he lacked (1 Corinthians 12:24-25), and the wife learned to yield her gifting in a way that allowed her husband to be the godly head of the home.

God can also give the necessary gift to those in such a marriage and in such a ministry team if they find themselves lacking. For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked: That there should be no schism [division] in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another –1 Corinthians 12:24-25. Is there ever a time to remove one from an office because of the lack of gifting? Maybe so, but let’s be very cautious, slow, careful, and prayerful.

In the case of church difficulty that seems to be due to the lack of gifting among the ordained, we need to consider the following verses. Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom. But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth. This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish. For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work. But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace. –James 3:13-18. Very rare is the case of church trouble involving church leadership when there is not a major lack by one or more of the ordained to be fully living out of God’s will and wisdom as defined herein.

The biblical answer to solving church problems that involves church leaders is three-fold. (1a) The leaders in question must humble their hearts in repentance before God and His Word, before the rest of the ordained, and where necessary before the local church. (1b) If the situation has deteriorated too much, then the wisdom of outside overseers should be sought. (2) The leaders who may be lacking in a specific gift should seek God through fervent prayer, both personally and of the local church, and should seek God’s provision for enabling ability through …the laying on of the hands of the presbytery –1 Timothy 4:14. (3) Then AFTER stability is restored the local brotherhood is at a good place to seek God’s will together about ordaining another brother to assist.

God’s Goal for Spiritual Gifts

I would see two main reasons for the gifts of the Spirit to be given to the Church.

The first reason is for the benefit of the church. In Ephesians we read: and he gave… [various spiritual gifts to believers] [to some this gift and to others a different gift] … For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: –Ephesians 4:11-12. First Corinthians chapter 12 has a long dialogue on how the gifts are to be utilized so as to benefit the body of Christ (the local church) and in verse 25 in particular, that there should be no schisms in the body, but that the members should have the same care one for another.

There are those who are going about preaching the need to have spiritual gifts, encouraging specific gifts such as evangelism, healing, miracles, and tongues, and it can be seen in many cases that this focused teaching actually causes divisions rather than unity. The Bible says that the gifts were given to bring the Church together and if it is not doing that, we should consider whether it is the real thing or if it is a counterfeit. I realize divisions happen for many reasons, but if the gifts in the body are not bringing together but dividing, we had better seek God for answers on why, because the gifts were meant to bring unity, oneness, and edification.

The second reason is for the benefit of the unbeliever. Some of the gifts were given as a sign for the unbeliever. Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe –1 Corinthians 14:22. We see that throughout the New Testament tongues, miracles and healings followed the gospel in places where it was being presented to those who had never heard it before. This was a way that God used to solidify and validate in the hearts and minds of the unbeliever that this gospel must be of God because of the supernatural manifestations. We see that tongues also followed the spreading of the gospel so that all could hear it in their own language as on the day of Pentecost.

I would consider these to be the two main reasons and are the primary purposes of the gifts. We would do well to evaluate our gifts in light of these two main reasons to be sure we have the real thing and are using them according to the purposes for which they were given.

It is interesting that of the 19 gifts we are considering, most of these will be best utilized in the local Church. Remember, God uses the church to reach the world. Some of the gifts given to the church are for reaching the world, for instance, the evangelist has a more unique calling to reach the world. Gifts like healings, miracles, and speaking in tongues are some of the gifts that are more prevalent on the frontier of the gospel. This is not to say that these gifts are never seen in the local church. My prayer is that if someone came into our services who cannot understand a word of English, and there is no one who can interpret the preaching of the Word into their language, then may God give us the gifts of tongues so that they might hear the gospel and be edified.

We have seen where there was sickness, and the elders of the church were called and there was anointing and prayer. At times God chose to miraculously heal. However, just because we (believers) have this wonderful gift of healing it does not necessarily mean that God wants all of us to be healed of every illness. The apostle Paul prayed three times to be healed from his recurring illness (2 Corinthians 12:7-12), yet God told him no. If he was not healed when he had healed many others, why would I think it needs to be different for me? So, it is with all the gifts that are given to the church; they are allowed by God to be exercised according to His will, not ours. It is absolutely essential for me and you to be a part of a local body so we will have the gifts of the Spirit working together through all the members, for the work of the church, in bringing unity, oneness, and edification, and for the ongoing work of the Church in calling men from a world of sin and calling them into His kingdom.

The Gift of Tongues

It is important to consider for a moment the spiritual gift of tongues and specifically the place it fills in the Kingdom of God. The Apostle Paul tells us they are given for a sign. Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe –1 Corinthians 14:22.

It is not a sign to the believer that he really has the Holy Spirit, but it is a sign to the unbeliever that the gospel message is real. The classic example was on the day of Pentecost. We do not determine Peter’s credibility because he spoke in another language. We all would agree without any doubt, that Peter was born again, and that the many different languages were not for his approval but rather so that the ones hearing would know that this speaking in many different languages was supernatural. It would have taken a stubborn soul to scoff at the message being preached that day.

Recently, I was made aware of studies that have been done by recording the gibberish that comprises most of what is called tongues today. Interestingly, they found that English speakers used English syllables in repetition, and that Spanish speaking people used Spanish syllables, thus, they deducted that most of what is called tongues today is a counterfeit where the person, in their own language, repeats syllables of their native tongue in repetition. I believe that in many cases it is done innocently because of the vast amount of deception that follows the speaking in tongues.

What I understand as the real thing is the example of a lady in Canada, who only knew French and did not understand any English. This woman happened to come to a revival meeting where the revivalist was preaching in English with no French interpreter. She responded in repentance to the message and those who counseled with her asked her how she understood the message, which was in English. She responded that what she had heard was shared in the most beautiful French she had ever heard. Clearly a miracle took place so that she would hear the message of salvation and be able to respond to it. I am sure it was heartwarming to know how it was supernatural that she was able to hear it. I suspect there is a good possibility that at times, the one speaking in tongues may not even be aware of it. Surely, if God could confound the languages of those working on the tower of Babel, He can also cause the words of an English-speaking preacher to be converted into French words before entering the ears of a French-speaking hearer.

The reason we find in scripture for the gift of speaking in tongues, is twofold, and is for the unbeliever who comes among us. The first reason is so that he would hear the gospel message in his own language. The second reason is that when he hears it miraculously in his own language and the one speaking does not know his language, it is a sign for the unbeliever to cause him to acknowledge that the message he is hearing is of God, and by God.

In conclusion, we find that two of the main purposes of God giving gifts to the church, giving them severally as He wills, is for the unity and edification of the body of Christ, and for the unbeliever to hear and be persuaded of the gospel message. Let us seriously consider whether the spiritual gifts we have and those gifts that are evident in our churches are fulfilling the purpose for which they were given.

أريد أن أفتتح هذا المقال عن المواهب الروحية بملاحظة آية مثيرة للاهتمام: لِذَلِكَ يَقُولُ: إِذَا صَعِدَ إِلَى الْعُلَا، أَخَذَ أَسْرَى، وَأَعْطَى النَّاسَ مَوَاهِبَ – أفسس 4:8. عبر التاريخ، عندما كان الملك يذهب إلى الحرب ضد مدينة وينتصر عليها، كان هو وجيشه يعودان إلى ديارهم ويستقبلهم شعبهم بحفاوة كبيرة. كانوا يمرّون في المدينة حاملين كل غنائم الحرب، ثم يقوم الملك بتوزيع هدايا مما أُخذ في المعركة، ويعطيها لشعبه.

كذلك، عندما صُلِبَ يسوع، فقد غلب العدو بواسطة موته وقيامته. نزع السلطان عن الموت والهاوية والقبر وعن الشيطان نفسه لأولئك الذين يتوبون ويؤمنون به. وعندما عاد إلى بيته (صعد إلى العُلَا) أعطى هدايا لشعبه—الكنيسة. هنا في أفسس، لدينا قائمة مُختصرة من المواهب الروحية: وَهُوَ أَعْطَى بَعْضَهُمْ رُسُلاً، وَبَعْضَهُمْ أَنْبِيَاءَ، وَبَعْضَهُمْ مُبَشِّرِينَ، وَبَعْضَهُمْ رُعَاةً وَمُعَلِّمِينَ – أفسس 4:11.

نلاحظ أوصافًا أكثر تفصيلاً لهذه المواهب الممنوحة للكنيسة في رسالة كورنثوس الأولى الإصحاح 12 سواء في بداية الإصحاح أو في نهايته، وفي رومية الإصحاح 12 آيات 6 إلى 8. في كورنثوس نرى المواهب الممنوحة التالية—كلمة حكمة، وكلمة معرفة، وإيمان، وشفاء، وعجائب، وألسنة، وتمييز الألسنة، ومساعدات، وحكومات. ثم في رومية، أُضيفت إلى قائمتنا مواهب أخرى—خدمة، وتوبيخ (تشجيع)، وعطاء، وحكم، وإظهار الرحمة.

إذا لم أخطئ، فهناك في المجمل 19 موهبة مُعطاة للكنيسة. يا له من ثراء من الهدايا قد أُعطي للكنيسة عندما صعد يسوع إلى العُلَا! سيكون من الجيد أن نقوم بدراسة متعمقة لكل واحدة من هذه المواهب حتى نتمكن من التعرف عليها في جماعاتنا. ومن الملاحظ أن أصدقائنا الخماسيي الحركة قد اختاروا بعض هذه المواهب مثل العجائب والشفاء والتكلم بالألسنة، ورفعوها فوق البقية، وجعلوها معيارًا للتحقق ما إذا كان الشخص مولودًا من جديد أو مغمورًا بالروح القدس، أو إذا كان أكثر روحانية من الذين يفتقرون إلى هذه المواهب. أو يمكننا أن نلاحظ كيف أن الإنجليكيين يميلون إلى نفس الشيء مع موهبة الوعظ/التبشير، والتي دخلت إلى العديد من كنائس الأنابابتيست المحافظة. أخيرًا، قد نفحص كيف أن بعض كنائس البساطة تختار فقط المواهب المتعلقة بحكم الكنيسة، وتتركها فقط للذين كُرسوا ليكون لهم مواهب، بينما تبقى معظم المواهب الأخرى غير معترف بها.

كل هذا يدفعني لطرح سؤال: «هل ينبغي أن نرفع موهبة أو موهبتين فوق الباقي ونركز عليهما، أم يجب أن تُعترف جميع المواهب على قدم المساواة؟» المرة الوحيدة التي أرى فيها رفع موهبة فوق البقية هي في رسالة بولس إلى الكورنثوس في الآية الأخيرة من الإصحاح 12، والآية الأولى في الإصحاح 14، حيث يحثهم على التمسك بأفضل موهبة والتي، بالقراءة المتأنية، سنلاحظ أنها تشير إلى النبوة. ومع استمرار قراءتنا المتأنية، نكتشف أن للنبوة أسبقية على التكلم بالألسنة لأن فهم الكورنثوس للتكلم بالألسنة كان يُساء استعماله ويُسيء، وقد لا تكون الكنيسة قد بُنِيَت بسلوكهم.

المواهب الروحية لا تبرر السلوك غير التقي

قد يكون من المناسب هنا كلمة تحذير. هناك تركيز من البعض على «معرفة ما هي موهبتي الروحية». أعتقد أن هذا قد يكون جيدًا، لكنه لا ينبغي أن يُستخدم كذريعة لتبرير سلوكي السيئ لأن «لدي هذه الموهبة وليس الأخرى». على سبيل المثال، قد يبرر النبي قسوته لأن موهبته هي النبوة؛ وبما أنه قد لا يمتلك موهبة الرحمة، قد يتأذى الناس بلا داعٍ. ربما سيكون لكل واحد منا موهبة أو مواهب أساسية. وبغض النظر عن مقدار محاولتنا أن نمتلك قدر الإمكان من المواهب، ستظل بعض المواهب طاغية أكثر من غيرها.

لقد سألْتُ العديد من الناس أي موهبة كانت الأساسية في حياة ربنا يسوع، والإجابة المختصرة أنها كان مملوءًا بالروح القدس بلا قياس وامتلكها كلها. وهذا صحيح، ولكن حتى هكذا، بما أننا جميعًا نريد أن نكون مثل يسوع، ربما ينبغي أن نتوقف عن تبرير أنفسنا بكوننا محدودين بموهبة واحدة ونسعى لأن نكون مجهزين بأكبر قدر ممكن. أعلم، وأنت تعلم، أنه في هذه الجسد لن نتقنها جميعًا ومع ذلك يجب أن نكون متقبلين لها جميعًا. بعد قول ذلك، يجب أن ندرك أننا مُصمَّمون على الاعتماد المتبادل؛ ولهذا السبب وزع يسوع هذه المواهب كل على حدة لكل إنسان وسنكون جميعًا لدينا موهبتنا الأساسية. «وَلكِنَّ هَذَا يَعْمَلُ كُلُّهُ ذَاكَ النَّفْسُ الْواحدةُ وَالرُّوحُ يَقْسِمُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى حِدَةٍ كَمَا يَشَاءُ» – كورنثوس الأولى 12:11. ومع ذلك، دعونا نكن حذرين ألا نبرر السلوك الخاطئ، أو من ناحية أخرى إهمال فعل الخير، لأن «حسنًا، هذه ليست موهبتي».

المواهب الروحية ليست هوية المسيحي

يجب أيضًا توخي الحذر عند السعي لفهم المواهب الروحية. لا ينبغي أن تكون هويتنا هي الموهبة التي نمتلكها، بل أن هويتنا هي في المسيح. نحن أبناء الملك؛ لسنا في المقام الأول نبيًا، أو معلمًا، أو مبشرًا. ومع ذلك، بوصفنا أبناء الملك، قد أُعطينا موهبة منه لنقوم بعمله، بسلطانه. إن الاعتراف أولًا وقبل كل شيء بمن نكون في المسيح سيبقينا في حالة جميلة من التواضع، لكن إن كانت هويتنا الأساسية «هذه الموهبة التي أملكها»، أظن أنه سيكون من الصعب ألا نقع في الكبرياء وبالتالي نفتح لأنفسنا كثيرًا من المخاطر والمزالق.

المواهب الروحية مُعطاة من الله، وليست مُنتَظرة من الإنسان

هل ينبغي أن يُعطى تحذير في الكيفية التي نطلب بها هذه الموهبة؟ ماذا يعني قول الكتاب أن الله يعطي المواهب بحسب اختياره؟ على سبيل المثال، اللَّهُ مُشْهِدًا بِهَذَا أَيْضًا بِآيَاتٍ وَعَجَائِبَ وَأَشْكَالِ أَعْمَالٍ، وَبِمَوَاهِبِ الرُّوحِ الْقُدُسِ، حَسَبَ مَشِيئَتِهِ؟ – عبرانيين 2:4. أو، وَكَلاَهَذِهِ يَعْمَلُ ذَاكُ النَّفْسُ الرُّوحُ الْوَاحِدُ، يُقَسِّمُ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ عَلَى حِدَةٍ كَمَا يَشَاءُ – كورنثوس الأولى 12:11.

هل تلاحظ في كلتا الآيتين تورط مَشِيئةِ الله بشكل كبير في إعطاء المواهب للكنيسة؟ ربما يجب أن يكون «سعينا للمواهب الروحية» في خلواتنا، نسأل الله أن يُصغّر قلبنا ويُلبسنا الموهبة التي يشاء أن يمنحها لنا لنكون أداة نافعة في جسد الكنيسة التي نحن جزء منها—«ليس مشيئتي بل مشيئتك». ربما قد أعطانا موهبة لا نُدركها أو لا نستخدمها، وما أحتاجه فعلاً هو أن أوقظ تلك الموهبة ولا أهملها، بل أستعملها في المكان الذي أملأه في الكنيسة. هل يمكن أن يكون ممكناً أنه إذا سعيت كثيرًا وراء موهبة روحية أخرى، فقد أحصل على بديل مزيف؟

أيضًا، من الجيد أن نذكر مباشرة مرة أخرى أنه عندما يكون هناك سعي مركز للمواهب الروحية عادة ما يتبعه بعض المشاكل السلبية. أحيانًا تُرفع فئةٌ مختارة وتُعلَّم أنها أكثر أهمية روحيًا، مثل التكلم بالألسنة، والعجائب، والشفاء. بعض الناس يروّجون أن لا قيمة تُذكر لتعليم المواهب الروحية وأن الوحيدة المناسبة لأيامنا هي تلك الخاصة بالقادة المُكرسين مثل الحكم، والرعاة، والمعلمين. بينما يستخدم بعض الناس فهمهم للمواهب الروحية ليصبحوا فردانيين ويرون قيمة قليلة في أن يكونوا جزءًا من جسد. هذا خطأ، لأن قراءة متأنية لهذه النصوص تُظهر لنا أن كل المواهب ضرورية حتى يتمكن الله من استخدام جميع المواهب بتعاون جميع الناس. هل من الممكن أنه حيث تُرفع مواهب معينة فوق الباقي، سواء كانت التكلم بالألسنة، والشفاءات، والعجائب؛ أو إن كانت التبشير؛ أو إن كانت تلك المناسبة أكثر للمرسومين من بيننا، قد يكون هناك عنصر غير معترف به من الكبرياء بيننا؟ نحن معرضون جدًا للوهم، لذا سيكون من الحكمة أن نتحقق من قلوبنا بدقة عند السعي وراء المواهب الروحية.

المواهب الروحية غير مدرجة في قائمة المؤهلات الكتابية لقيادة الكنيسة

قال بولس لتيموثاوس: «لا تُهْمِلْ الموهبةَ التي فيك، التي أُنْعِمَتْ عليكَ بموضع النبوة مع وضع الأيدي من قِبل الإيبارشية» – تيموثاوس الأولى 4:14. ربما بدلًا من السعي لاقتناء موهبة، نحتاج إلى التوقف عن إهمال الموهبة التي وُهبت لنا. بدل أن نطلب شيئًا جديدًا ومثيرًا، يجب أن نوقظ الموهبة التي نملكها. لقد حدث أن رُفِعَ رجالٌ من مناصبهم لأنهم لم يمتلكوا الموهبة التي كُرسوا من أجلها. سأكون بطيئًا ومتحسبًا جدًا وأصلي كثيرًا قبل أن أُزيح أخًا مكرسًا من منصبه لهذا السبب. ألا يكون من الأفضل أن نصلي أن يزيد الله تلك الموهبة التي أُعطيت له بوضع الأيدي؟ أن نستخلص بسرعة أنه لا يمتلك الموهبة قد يكون مجرد مخرج سهل.

لن نفعل ذلك في الزواج. كم مرة كانت الزوجة أكثر موهبةً في القيادة من زوجها؟ فسخ الزواج ليس خيارًا، ولا خيار إضافة شخص ثالث إلى رابط الزواج لإعادة التوازن لما يُعتقد أنه نقص في المواهب. لقد رأينا كثيرًا أنه عندما وُجِهت حالة مثل هذه بالصلاة وبالروح القدس، أعطى الله للزوج ما كان ينقصه (كورنثوس الأولى 12:24-25)، وتعلمت الزوجة أن تُسَلِّم موهبتها بطريقة تتيح لزوجها أن يكون الرأس المتقي للبيت.

يمكن أيضًا أن يمنح الله الموهبة اللازمة لأولئك في مثل هذا الزواج وفي مثل هذا فريق الخدمة إن وجدوا أنفسهم ناقصين. «فَأَمَّا أَحْسَنُ أَعْضَائِنَا فَلَيْسَ لَهُ حَاجَةٌ، بَلِ اللهُ قَدِ اشْتَرَبَ الجَسَدَ مَعًا، مُعْطِيًا كَثْرَةَ الشَّرَفِ لِلْعَضُوِ الَّذِي كَانَ يَنْقُصُ، لِكَيْ لا يَكُونَ تَشَتُّتٌ فِي الْجَسَدِ، بَلْ تَكُونُ الأَعْضَاءُ مُهْتَمِّةً بَعْضُهَا بِبَعْضٍ» – كورنثوس الأولى 12:24-25. هل هناك وقت يُنزع فيه أحد من منصبه بسبب نقص الموهبة؟ ربما نعم، لكن لِنَكُنْ حذرين جدًا، بطيئين، متحسّبين، ومُصلين.

في حالة صعوبة كنسية تبدو ناجمة عن نقص الموهبة بين المرسومين، نحتاج إلى النظر في الآيات التالية. مَنْ هُوَ الرَّجُلُ الْحَكِيمُ وَالْمَلِيءُ مَعْرِفَةً بَيْنَكُمْ؟ فَلْيُظْهِرْ مِنْ سُلُوكِهِ الْحَسَنِ أَعْمَالَهُ بِمُسَاكِنَةِ الحِكْمَةِ. وَلَكِنْ إِنْ كَانَ فِي قُلُوبِكُمْ حَسَدٌ مُرٌّ وَخِصَامٌ، فَلا تَفْتَخِرُوا وَلَا تَكْذِبُوا عَلَى الْحَقِّ. فَتِلْكَ الْحِكْمَةُ لا تنْزِلُ مِنَ الْفَوْقِ، بَلْ هِيَ أَرْضِيَّةٌ، شَهَوِيَّةٌ، شَيْطَانِيَّةٌ. فَحَيْثُ الْحَسَدُ وَالْخِصَامُ هُنَاكَ خَلَلٌ وَكُلُّ عَمَلٍ رَدِيءٍ. أَمَّا الْحِكْمَةُ الْمِنْ فَوْقٍ فَأَوَّلاً طَاهِرَةٌ، ثُمَّ سَالِمَةٌ، لَطِيفَةٌ، سَهْلَةُ الْقَبُولِ، مَمْلُوءَةٌ رَحْمَةً وَثِمَارًا صَالِحَةً، بِلا مَيْلٍ، وَبِلا نَفَاقٍ. وَيُزْرَعُ ثَمَرُ البِرِّ فِي سَالِمِيِّنَ الَّذِينَ يُصْنَعُونَ السَّلاَمَ – يعقوب 3:13-18. نادرًا ما تكون حالة مشكلة كنسية تنطوي على قيادة الكنيسة دون وجود نقص كبير لدى واحد أو أكثر من المرسومين في أن يعيشوا بالكامل حسب مشيئة الله وحكمته كما هو معرف هنا.

الإجابة الكتابية على حل مشاكل الكنيسة التي تشمل قادة الكنيسة ثلاثية. (1أ) يجب أن يُخْضِعَ القادة المعنيون قلوبهم بالتوبة أمام الله وكلمته، وأمام باقي المرسومين، وعند الضرورة أمام الكنيسة المحلية. (1ب) إن ساءت الحالة كثيرًا، فحينئذٍ يجب طلب حكمة مشرفين خارجيين. (2) يجب على القادة الذين قد يفتقرون إلى موهبة محددة أن يطلبوا من الله بواسطة صلاة حارة، سواء شخصيًا أو صلاة الكنيسة المحلية، وأن يطلبوا عطاء الله لتمكين القدرة بواسطة …وَضْعِ الأَيَادِي مِنْ قِبَلِ الإِيبَارِشِيَّةِ – تيموثاوس الأولى 4:14. (3) ثم بَعْدَ استعادة الاستقرار تُصْبِح الأُخُوَّةُ المحلية في موقفٍ جيدٍ لِطَلَبِ مَشِيئَةِ اللهِ معًا بشأن تسيم أخٍ آخر للمساعدة.

غاية الله من المواهب الروحية

أرى سببين رئيسيين لمنح مواهب الروح للكنيسة.

السبب الأول هو من أجل منفعة الكنيسة. في أفسس نقرأ: وَهُوَ أَعْطَى… [مَوَاهِبَ مُخْتَلِفَةً لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ] … لِـتَمَامِ الْقِدِّيسِينَ، لِـعَمَلِ الْخِدْمَةِ، لِـبُنْيَةِ جَسَدِ الْمَسِيحِ: – أفسس 4:11-12. الإصحاح 12 من كورنثوس الأولى يحوي حوارًا طويلاً حول كيفية استخدام المواهب بحيث تفيد جسد المسيح (الكنيسة المحلية)، وفي الآية 25 على وجه الخصوص، كي لا يكون هناك تشقق في الجسد، بل ليكون الأعضاء يهتمون ببعضهم البعض.

هناك من يذهبون ينادون بضرورة وجود مواهب روحية، ويشجعون مواهب محددة مثل التبشير والشفاء والعجائب والألسنة، وفي كثير من الحالات يتضح أن هذا التعليم المركز في الواقع يسبب انقسامًا بدل الوحدة. يقول الكتاب إن المواهب أُعطيت لتجمع الكنيسة وإذا لم تكن تفعل ذلك، يجب أن نفكر هل هو أمر حقيقي أم مقلد. أدرك أن الانقسامات تحدث لأسباب كثيرة، لكن إن كانت المواهب في الجسد لا تجمع بل تفرق، فمن الأفضل أن نطلب من الله أن يجيبنا لماذا، لأن المواهب كانت مقصودة أن تجلب الوحدة والاتحاد والبناء.

السبب الثاني هو من أجل منفعة غير المؤمن. بعض المواهب أُعطيت كآية لغير المؤمن. لِذَلِكَ فَالأَلْسِنَةُ لآيَةٍ، لا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ، بَلْ لِـلْغَيْرِ مُؤْمِنِينَ، أَمَّا النُّبُوَّةُ فَلَيْسَتْ لِـلْغَيْرِ مُؤْمِنِينَ بَلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ – كورنثوس الأولى 14:22. نرى في العهد الجديد أن الألسنة والعجائب والشفاءات تبعت البشارة في أماكن كان يُعرض فيها الإنجيل لأولئك الذين لم يسمعوه من قبل. كانت هذه وسيلة استخدمها الله لترسيخ وتأكيد في قلوب وعقول غير المؤمن أن هذا الإنجيل لا بد أن يكون من الله بسبب الظواهر الخارقة. نرى أيضًا أن الألسنة تبعت انتشار الإنجيل حتى يسمع الجميع بلغتهم كما في يوم الخمسين.

أعتبر هذين السببين هما الغرضان الرئيسيان والأوليان للمواهب. سيكون من الحكمة أن نقيم مواهبنا في ضوء هذين السببَين الرئيسيين لنتأكد أن ما لدينا حقيقي ونستخدمه وفق الأغراض التي أعطي من أجلها.

من المثير أن نلاحظ أن من بين 19 موهبة ندرسها، سيُستثمر معظمها أفضل استثمار في الكنيسة المحلية. تذكر، الله يستخدم الكنيسة للوصول إلى العالم. بعض المواهب المعطاة للكنيسة مخصصة للوصول إلى العالم، على سبيل المثال، للمبشر دعوة أكثر خصوصية للوصول إلى العالم. مواهب مثل الشفاء والعجائب والتكلم بالألسنة هي من المواهب الأبرز على جبهة الإنجيل. وهذا لا يعني أن هذه المواهب لا تظهر أبدًا في الكنيسة المحلية. صلاتي أن إذا دخل أحد خدماتنا لا يفهم كلمة إنجليزية واحدة، ولم يكن هناك من يترجم وعظ الكلمة إلى لغته، فليبسط الله علينا مواهب الألسنة حتى يسمعوا الإنجيل ويبنوا.

لقد رأينا حالات مرضٍ دُعي فيها شيوخ الكنيسة ثم كانت هناك مسحة وصلوات. أحيانًا اختار الله أن يشفي بطريقة معجزة. ومع ذلك، مجرد أن لنا (نحن المؤمنين) هذه الموهبة الرائعة للشفاء لا يعني بالضرورة أن الله يريد أن يُشفى كل واحد منا من كل مرض. صلّى الرسول بولس ثلاث مرات أن يُشْفَى من مرضه المتكرر (كورنثوس الثانية 12:7-12)، ومع ذلك أخبره الله لا. إذا لم يُشْفَ عندما شفى كثيرين آخرين، لماذا أظن أنه يجب أن يكون الأمر مختلفًا بالنسبة لي؟ هكذا هو شأن كل المواهب المعطاة للكنيسة؛ يُسمَح بممارستها بحسب مشيئة الله، لا مشيئتنا. من الضروري جدًا أن تكون جزءًا من جسد محلي حتى تعمل مواهب الروح معًا عبر جميع الأعضاء، من أجل عمل الكنيسة، في جلب الوحدة والاتحاد والبناء، ومن أجل العمل المستمر للكنيسة في دعوة الناس من عالم الخطيئة ودعوتهم إلى ملكوته.

موهبة الألسنة

من المهم أن نأخذ لحظة ونتأمل موهبة الألسنة والمكان الذي تحتله في ملكوت الله. يخبرنا الرسول بولس أنها تعطى كآية. لِذَلِكَ الأَلْسِنَةُ لآيَةٌ، لا لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ، بَلْ لِـلْغَيْرِ مُؤْمِنِينَ، أَمَّا النُّبُوَّةُ فَلَيْسَتْ لِـلْغَيْرِ مُؤْمِنِينَ بَلْ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ – كورنثوس الأولى 14:22.

ليست آيةً للمؤمن كي يعرف أنه فعلاً له الروح القدس، بل هي آية لغير المؤمن لكي يعلَم أن رسالة الإنجيل حقيقية. المثال الكلاسيكي هو يوم الخمسين. لا نستخلص مصداقية بطرس لأنه تكلم بلغة أخرى. كلنا نتفق دون شك أن بطرس كان مولودًا من جديد، وأن اختلاف اللغات لم يكن للموافقة عليه بل لكي يعلم المستمعون أن التكلم بتلك اللغات كان خارقًا. لقد كان يحتاج مرء عنيد ليستهزئ بتلك الرسالة المعلنة يومئذ.

مؤخرًا علمت بدراسات أُجريت على تسجيل الهراء الذي يشكل معظم ما يدعى اليوم بالألسنة. ومن المثير أنهم وجدوا أن متحدثي الإنجليزية استخدموا مقاطع إنجليزية متكررة، وأن الناطقين بالإسبانية استخدموا مقاطع إسبانية، فاستنتجوا أن معظم ما يدعى اليوم بالألسنة هو تقليد حيث يُكرر الشخص مقاطعٍ من لغته الأم. أعتقد أن في كثيرٍ من الحالات يُمارَس ذلك ببراءة نظراً لوفرة الخداع المصاحب للتكلم بالألسنة.

ما أفهمه على أنه الحقيقي هو مثال سيدة في كندا، كانت تعرف الفرنسية فقط ولا تفهم الإنجليزية. جاءت هذه المرأة إلى اجتماع صحوة حيث كان الواعظ يعظ بالإنجليزية دون مترجم فرنسي. استجابت بالتوبة للرسالة وسألها من نصحها كيف فهمت الرسالة التي كانت بالإنجليزية. أجابت أن ما سمعته نُقل بأجمل فرنسية قد سمعته في حياتها. بوضوح حصلت معجزة حتى تسمع رسالة الخلاص وتستطيع الاستجابة لها. لا شك أنه كان من المشوّق أن تعرف أنها سمعت بشكل خارق. أشكّ أن المتكلم بالألسنة قد يكون أحيانًا غير مدرك لذلك. لا شك أنه إذا استطاع الله إرباك لسان أولئك العاملين على برج بابل، فبوسعه أيضًا أن يجعل كلمات واعظٍ إنجليزي تُحَوَّل إلى كلمات فرنسية قبل أن تدخل إلى آذان سامع فرنسي.

السببان اللذان نجدهما في الكتاب المقدس لموهبة التكلم بالألسنة هما ثنائيان، وموجهان لغير المؤمن الذي يأتي بيننا. السبب الأول أن يسمع رسالة الإنجيل بلغته الخاصة. السبب الثاني أنه عندما يسمعها معجزيًا بلغته الخاصة والشخص المتكلم لا يعرف لغته، تكون آية لغير المؤمن تدفعه للاعتراف بأن الرسالة التي يسمعها هي من الله وبواسطته.

خلاصة القول، نجد أن غرضي الله الرئيسيين من إعطاء المواهب للكنيسة، وتوزيعها كلٌ على حدة كما يشاء، هما للوحدة وبناء جسد المسيح، ولكي يسمع غير المؤمن ويقتنع برسالة الإنجيل. لِنُمعِنْ التفكير جدياً فيما إذا كانت المواهب الروحية التي لدينا وتلك الظاهرة في كنائسنا تحقق الغرض الذي أُعطيت من أجله.

I want to introduce this article on Spiritual Gifts by observing an interesting verse: Wherefore he saith, When he ascended up on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts unto men –Ephesians 4:8. Throughout history, when a king went to battle against a city and conquered it, he and his army returned home, to be greeted by their people with great fanfare. They would march through the city with all the spoils of war, after which the king would hand out gifts from the stuff that was taken in battle, giving it to his people.

Likewise, when Jesus was crucified, through His death and resurrection, He conquered the enemy. He took the power from death, hell, the grave and from Satan himself for those who repent and believe in Him. When He returned home (ascended up on high) He gave gifts to His people— the Church. Here in Ephesians, we have a condensed list of spiritual gifts: And he [God] gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers –Ephesians 4:11.

We observe more detailed descriptions of these gifts given to the Church in 1 Corinthians chapter 12 both at the beginning of the chapter and the end of the chapter and in Romans chapter 12 verses 6 to 8. In 1 Corinthians we see the following gifts given—the word of wisdom, the word of knowledge, faith, healing, miracles, tongues, discerning of tongues, helps, and governments. Then, in Romans, we have more gifts added to our list—ministry, exhortation, giving, ruling, and showing mercy.

If I did not miss any, there is a total of 19 gifts given to the church. What a wealth of gifts have been given to the church when Jesus ascended up on high! It would be good for us to do a thorough study on each one of these gifts so that we would be able to recognize them in our congregations. One thing that could be observed is that our Pentecostal friends have taken a select few of these gifts such as miracles, healing, and speaking in tongues, and have held them above the rest, making them a validation of whether a person is born again, baptized in the Holy Spirit, or if they are more spiritual than those lacking these gifts. Or we could consider how the evangelicals tend to do the same with the gift of evangelism, which has made inroads into many conservative Anabaptist churches. Finally, we might examine how some of us plain churches take only the gifts that have to do with Church government, leaving it only to those who are ordained to have gifts, while most all the rest of the gifts are left unrecognized.

This all leads me to ask the question, “Should we be lifting one or two gifts out above the rest and emphasizing them, or should all of the gifts be recognized equally?” The only time that I see one lifted above the rest is in Paul’s letter to the Corinthians in the last verse of Chapter 12, and the first verse in chapter 14, where he exhorts them to covet after the best gift which, with careful reading, we will notice is referring to prophesy. As we continue with our careful reading, we discover that prophecy should hold precedence over speaking in tongues since apparently the Corinthian understanding of speaking in tongues was being abused and misused and the Church might not have been edified by their behavior.

Spiritual Gifts Should Not Excuse Ungodly Behavior

A word of caution might be in order here. There is an emphasis by some, on “knowing what my spiritual gift is.” I think this can be good, but it should not be done to the fault of excusing myself for bad behavior because “I have this gift and not the other.” For example, the prophet might excuse himself for being harsh because his gift is that of a prophet; since he may not have the gift of mercy, people may be unnecessarily hurt. We will all probably have a primary gift or gifts. As much as we may try to be well-equipped with as many of the gifts as we can, some will still be more dominant than others.

I have asked numerous people which gift was primary in the life of our Lord Jesus and the short answer is that He was full of the Holy Ghost and without measure and had them all. True enough, but even so, since we all want to be like Jesus, maybe we should stop excusing ourselves to one limited gift and pursue to be as fully equipped as possible. I know, and you know, that in this flesh we will not master them all and yet we should be receptive to them all. Having said that, we must realize, we are meant to be interdependent; that is why Jesus handed out these gifts severally to each man and we will all have our primary gift or gifts. But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will –1 Corinthians 12:11. Nevertheless, let’s be careful that we do not excuse wrong behavior, or, on the other hand, negligence of doing good, because “Well, that is just not my gift”.

Spiritual Gifts Are Not The Christian’s Identity

A couple of cautions may also be in place when seeking to understand spiritual gifts. Our identity should not be the gift that we have but rather that our identity is in Christ. We are a child of the King; we are not primarily a prophet, a teacher, or an evangelist. However, in being a child of the King, we have been given a gift by Him, to do His work, with His power. Recognizing first and foremost who we are in Christ will keep us in a beautiful place of humility, but if our primary identity is “this gift that I have,” I suppose it would be hard not to fall into pride and thus we open ourselves up to many pitfalls and dangers.

Spiritual Gifts Are God-Given, Not To Be Sought After By Man

Could there be a caution given in how we seek this gift? What does it mean when the Scripture says that God gives gifts according to His choosing? For instance, God also bearing them witness, both with signs and wonders, and with divers miracles, and gifts of the Holy Ghost, according to his own will? –Hebrews 2:4. Or, But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will –1 Corinthians 12:11.

Do you notice in both verses the WILL of God being very involved in the giving of gifts in the Church? Maybe our “seeking spiritual gifts” should be done alone in our closet, asking God to make me humble and endue me with whatever gift He wants me to have to make me a useful tool in the church body that I am a part of—“Not my will, but thine be done”. Maybe He has given me a gift that I am not recognizing or using, and what I actually need is to stir up that gift and not neglect it, but rather use it in the place I fill in the church. Could it be possible that, if I were to seek enough after another spiritual gift, I just might get myself a counterfeit?

Also, it would be good to mention very directly again that when there is a focused seeking after spiritual gifts usually there is some resulting negative problem. Sometimes a select few are lifted out and taught to be more spiritually important, such as speaking in tongues, miracles, and healing. Some will promote that there is little to no value in the teaching of spiritual gifts and that the only ones which are for our day are the ones pertaining to the ordained church leaders such as government, pastors, and teachers. While some people use their understanding of spiritual gifts to become individualistic and they see little value in being a part of a body. This is wrong, since a careful reading of these Scriptures show us that ALL the gifts are essential so that God will have the ability to make use of all the gifts by a collaboration of all the people. Could it be possible that where certain gifts are elevated above the rest, whether it is speaking in tongues, healings, and miracles; or if it is evangelism; or if it is those more suited for the ordained among us, that there could be an unrecognized element of pride in our midst? We are so prone to disillusionment that it would be good to check our hearts thoroughly when seeking after spiritual gifts.

Spiritual Gifts Are Not Included In The Biblical List of Qualifications For Church Leaders

Paul told Timothy, Neglect not the gift that is in thee, which was given thee by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the presbytery –1 Timothy 4:14. Maybe rather than seeking out a gift, we need to stop neglecting the gift that has been given to us. Rather than seeking something new and exciting, we should stir up the gift we do have. It has happened that men in leadership have been removed from their post, because they do not have the gift for that which they were ordained. I would be very slow and very prayerful before removing an ordained brother from his office for that reason. Would it not be better to pray that God would increase that gift that had been given him by the laying on of hands? To quickly conclude that he does not have the gift may just be the easy way out.

We would never do that in a marriage. How often has it happened that a wife was more gifted in leadership than her husband? Disannulling the marriage is not an option, nor is it an option to add a third person to the marriage union to bring balance to the perceived lack of a proper balance of gifting. We have often seen that when prayer and the Holy Ghost was involved in a situation like this, God gave the husband what he lacked (1 Corinthians 12:24-25), and the wife learned to yield her gifting in a way that allowed her husband to be the godly head of the home.

God can also give the necessary gift to those in such a marriage and in such a ministry team if they find themselves lacking. For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked: That there should be no schism [division] in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another –1 Corinthians 12:24-25. Is there ever a time to remove one from an office because of the lack of gifting? Maybe so, but let’s be very cautious, slow, careful, and prayerful.

In the case of church difficulty that seems to be due to the lack of gifting among the ordained, we need to consider the following verses. Who is a wise man and endued with knowledge among you? let him shew out of a good conversation his works with meekness of wisdom. But if ye have bitter envying and strife in your hearts, glory not, and lie not against the truth. This wisdom descendeth not from above, but is earthly, sensual, devilish. For where envying and strife is, there is confusion and every evil work. But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceable, gentle, and easy to be intreated, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy. And the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace of them that make peace. –James 3:13-18. Very rare is the case of church trouble involving church leadership when there is not a major lack by one or more of the ordained to be fully living out of God’s will and wisdom as defined herein.

The biblical answer to solving church problems that involves church leaders is three-fold. (1a) The leaders in question must humble their hearts in repentance before God and His Word, before the rest of the ordained, and where necessary before the local church. (1b) If the situation has deteriorated too much, then the wisdom of outside overseers should be sought. (2) The leaders who may be lacking in a specific gift should seek God through fervent prayer, both personally and of the local church, and should seek God’s provision for enabling ability through …the laying on of the hands of the presbytery –1 Timothy 4:14. (3) Then AFTER stability is restored the local brotherhood is at a good place to seek God’s will together about ordaining another brother to assist.

God’s Goal for Spiritual Gifts

I would see two main reasons for the gifts of the Spirit to be given to the Church.

The first reason is for the benefit of the church. In Ephesians we read: and he gave… [various spiritual gifts to believers] [to some this gift and to others a different gift] … For the perfecting of the saints, for the work of the ministry, for the edifying of the body of Christ: –Ephesians 4:11-12. First Corinthians chapter 12 has a long dialogue on how the gifts are to be utilized so as to benefit the body of Christ (the local church) and in verse 25 in particular, that there should be no schisms in the body, but that the members should have the same care one for another.

There are those who are going about preaching the need to have spiritual gifts, encouraging specific gifts such as evangelism, healing, miracles, and tongues, and it can be seen in many cases that this focused teaching actually causes divisions rather than unity. The Bible says that the gifts were given to bring the Church together and if it is not doing that, we should consider whether it is the real thing or if it is a counterfeit. I realize divisions happen for many reasons, but if the gifts in the body are not bringing together but dividing, we had better seek God for answers on why, because the gifts were meant to bring unity, oneness, and edification.

The second reason is for the benefit of the unbeliever. Some of the gifts were given as a sign for the unbeliever. Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe –1 Corinthians 14:22. We see that throughout the New Testament tongues, miracles and healings followed the gospel in places where it was being presented to those who had never heard it before. This was a way that God used to solidify and validate in the hearts and minds of the unbeliever that this gospel must be of God because of the supernatural manifestations. We see that tongues also followed the spreading of the gospel so that all could hear it in their own language as on the day of Pentecost.

I would consider these to be the two main reasons and are the primary purposes of the gifts. We would do well to evaluate our gifts in light of these two main reasons to be sure we have the real thing and are using them according to the purposes for which they were given.

It is interesting that of the 19 gifts we are considering, most of these will be best utilized in the local Church. Remember, God uses the church to reach the world. Some of the gifts given to the church are for reaching the world, for instance, the evangelist has a more unique calling to reach the world. Gifts like healings, miracles, and speaking in tongues are some of the gifts that are more prevalent on the frontier of the gospel. This is not to say that these gifts are never seen in the local church. My prayer is that if someone came into our services who cannot understand a word of English, and there is no one who can interpret the preaching of the Word into their language, then may God give us the gifts of tongues so that they might hear the gospel and be edified.

We have seen where there was sickness, and the elders of the church were called and there was anointing and prayer. At times God chose to miraculously heal. However, just because we (believers) have this wonderful gift of healing it does not necessarily mean that God wants all of us to be healed of every illness. The apostle Paul prayed three times to be healed from his recurring illness (2 Corinthians 12:7-12), yet God told him no. If he was not healed when he had healed many others, why would I think it needs to be different for me? So, it is with all the gifts that are given to the church; they are allowed by God to be exercised according to His will, not ours. It is absolutely essential for me and you to be a part of a local body so we will have the gifts of the Spirit working together through all the members, for the work of the church, in bringing unity, oneness, and edification, and for the ongoing work of the Church in calling men from a world of sin and calling them into His kingdom.

The Gift of Tongues

It is important to consider for a moment the spiritual gift of tongues and specifically the place it fills in the Kingdom of God. The Apostle Paul tells us they are given for a sign. Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe –1 Corinthians 14:22.

It is not a sign to the believer that he really has the Holy Spirit, but it is a sign to the unbeliever that the gospel message is real. The classic example was on the day of Pentecost. We do not determine Peter’s credibility because he spoke in another language. We all would agree without any doubt, that Peter was born again, and that the many different languages were not for his approval but rather so that the ones hearing would know that this speaking in many different languages was supernatural. It would have taken a stubborn soul to scoff at the message being preached that day.

Recently, I was made aware of studies that have been done by recording the gibberish that comprises most of what is called tongues today. Interestingly, they found that English speakers used English syllables in repetition, and that Spanish speaking people used Spanish syllables, thus, they deducted that most of what is called tongues today is a counterfeit where the person, in their own language, repeats syllables of their native tongue in repetition. I believe that in many cases it is done innocently because of the vast amount of deception that follows the speaking in tongues.

What I understand as the real thing is the example of a lady in Canada, who only knew French and did not understand any English. This woman happened to come to a revival meeting where the revivalist was preaching in English with no French interpreter. She responded in repentance to the message and those who counseled with her asked her how she understood the message, which was in English. She responded that what she had heard was shared in the most beautiful French she had ever heard. Clearly a miracle took place so that she would hear the message of salvation and be able to respond to it. I am sure it was heartwarming to know how it was supernatural that she was able to hear it. I suspect there is a good possibility that at times, the one speaking in tongues may not even be aware of it. Surely, if God could confound the languages of those working on the tower of Babel, He can also cause the words of an English-speaking preacher to be converted into French words before entering the ears of a French-speaking hearer.

The reason we find in scripture for the gift of speaking in tongues, is twofold, and is for the unbeliever who comes among us. The first reason is so that he would hear the gospel message in his own language. The second reason is that when he hears it miraculously in his own language and the one speaking does not know his language, it is a sign for the unbeliever to cause him to acknowledge that the message he is hearing is of God, and by God.

In conclusion, we find that two of the main purposes of God giving gifts to the church, giving them severally as He wills, is for the unity and edification of the body of Christ, and for the unbeliever to hear and be persuaded of the gospel message. Let us seriously consider whether the spiritual gifts we have and those gifts that are evident in our churches are fulfilling the purpose for which they were given.

Napenda kuanzisha makala hii kuhusu Zawadi za Kiroho kwa kutambua mstari wa ajabu: “Kwa sababu hiyo anasema, Alipoongeza juu, alipeleka mafungwa kwa ufalme, na akawapa wanadamu zawadi” – Waefeso 4:8. Katika historia, wakati mfalme alipokwenda kupigania mji na kuushinda, yeye na jeshi lake wangerudi nyumbani wakipokelewa kwa shangwe na watu wao. Wangeingia mjini wakiwa na mateka na maghorofa yote ya vita, na baada ya hapo mfalme angenunua zawadi kutoka kwa vitu vilivyopatikana vita, akivitolea watu wake.

Vivyo hivyo, wakati Yesu aliteswa msalabani, kupitia kifo chake na ufufuo wake, alimshinda adui. Alipokea mamlaka juu ya kifo, kuzimu, kaburi na hata kwa Shetani mwenyewe kwa ajili ya wale wanaotubu na kumwamini Yeye. Aliporudi nyumbani (alipoongeza juu) aliwapa watu wake zawadi—kanisa. Hapa katika Waefeso, tuna orodha iliyoshinifishwa ya zawadi za kiroho: “Na yeye [Mungu] aliwapa wengine mitume; wengine manabii; wengine wainjilisti; wengine wachungaji na walimu” – Waefeso 4:11.

Tunaona maelezo ya kina zaidi ya zawadi hizi zilizotolewa kwa Kanisa katika 1 Wakorintho sura ya 12 mwanzoni na mwishoni mwa sura hiyo na pia katika Warumi sura ya 12 vifungu 6 hadi 8. Katika 1 Wakorintho tunaona zawadi zifuatazo zikitolewa—neno la hekima, neno la maarifa, imani, uponyaji, miujiza, lugha, kutambua lugha, misaada, na utawala. Kisha, katika Warumi, tunaongeza zawadi nyingine kwenye orodha—huduma, wananihimiza, kutoa, kutawala, na kuonyesha rehema.

Kama sikosei, jumla ya zawadi ni 19 zilizotolewa kwa kanisa. Ni utajiri gani wa zawadi ulitolewa kwa kanisa wakati Yesu alipoongeza juu! Itakuwa nzuri tufanye utafiti wa kina juu ya kila moja ya zawadi hizi ili tuweze kuzitambua katika makanisa yetu. Jambo moja linaloweza kutambulika ni jinsi marafiki wetu wa Pentecoste walivyochukua chache za zawadi hizi kama miujiza, uponyaji, na kuongea kwa lugha, na kuziweka juu ya zote nyingine, zikawa uthibitisho wa kama mtu ni kuzaliwa upya, ametapakuliwa kwa Roho Mtakatifu, au kama wao ni wa kiroho zaidi kuliko walio bila zawadi hizi. Au tunaweza kuzingatia jinsi waundenominationali hufanya vivyo hivyo na zawadi ya uinjilisti, ambayo imeingia kwa makanisa mengi ya Anabaptisti waliolindwa. Mwisho, tunaweza kuchunguza jinsi baadhi ya makanisa yetu ya jadi yanavyochukua tu zawadi zinazohusiana na utawala wa Kanisa, zikiziweka kwa wale walioteuliwa tu kuwa na zawadi, wakati karibu zote zawadi zingine hazitambuliki.

Hili yote linanitia kujiuliza swali, “Je, tunapaswa kuinua zawadi moja au mbili juu ya zingine na kuzijazia uzito, au je, zawadi zote zinapaswa kutambulika kwa usawa?” Mara pekee ninayoona moja ikiwekwa juu ya nyingine ni katika barua ya Paulo kwa Wakorintho katika kifungu cha mwisho cha sura ya 12, na aya ya kwanza ya sura ya 14, ambapo anawahimiza wakutamani zawadi bora ambayo, kwa kusoma kwa uangalifu, tutaona inahusu unabii. Tunapoendelea kusoma kwa uangalifu, tunagundua kwamba unabii unapaswa kuwa wa kipaumbele juu ya kuongea kwa lugha kwani kwa dhahiri uelewa wa Wakorintho wa kuongea kwa lugha ulikuwa unanyonywa na kutumika vibaya na Kanisa huenda hakujajengwa kwa tabia yao.

Zawadi za Kiroho Haizuili Tabia Isiyo ya Mungu

Maneno ya tahadhari yanaweza kuwekwa hapa. Kuna uzito kwa baadhi, juu ya “kujua ni zawadi gani ya kiroho niliyo nayo.” Nafikiri hili linaweza kuwa zuri, lakini halipaswi kutumika kuwa msamaha wa tabia mbaya kwa kusema “nina zawadi hii na sio nyingine.” Kwa mfano, nabii anaweza kujidanganya kwa kuwa mkali kwa sababu zawadi yake ni ya unabii; kwa kuwa yeye hana zawadi ya huruma, watu wanaweza kujeruhiwa bila sababu. Sisi sote huenda tukiwa na zawadi kuu au zawadi kuu ndogo. Kadiri tujaribu kuwa na zana kwa zawadi nyingi kadri tunavyoweza, bado baadhi zitabaki kuwa za nguvu zaidi kuliko nyingine.

Nimewauliza watu wengi ni zawadi gani iliyokuwa kuu katika maisha ya Bwana wetu Yesu na jibu fupi ni kwamba Yeye alikuwa amejaa Roho Mtakatifu isiyopimika na alikuwa nazo zote. Ni kweli, lakini hata hivyo, kwa kuwa sisi sote tunataka kuwa kama Yesu, labda tunapaswa kuacha kujimwagia msamaha kwa kuwa na zawadi ndogo tu na kujaribu kupata zana kwa kadri ya uwezo. Najua, nawe unajua, kuwa katika mwili huu hatutazipasua zote zote na bado tunapaswa kuwa tayari kwa zote. Hii ikisemwa, lazima tutambue kwamba tumetengenezwa kuhitaji kila mmoja; ndiyo maana Yesu aligawanya zawadi hizi kwa kila mtu pekee na sote tutakuwa na zawadi kuu. Lakini yote haya hufanya huo mmoja na Roho mmoja huyo anagawanya kwa kila mtu pekee kama anavyotaka – 1 Wakorintho 12:11. Hata hivyo, tuweke tahadhari kwamba tusitumie zawadi kuhalalisha tabia mbaya, au, kwa upande mwingine, kutofuata kufanya mema kwa kusema “Hilo si zawadi yangu.”

Zawadi za Kiroho Si Utambulisho wa Mkristo

Kumbuka tahadhari kadhaa pia zinapaswa kuwekwa tunapotafuta kuelewa zawadi za kiroho. Utambulisho wetu haupaswi kuwa zawadi tuliyonayo bali utambulisho wetu upo katika Kristo. Sisi ni watoto wa Mfalme; hatuwezi kuwa kwa msingi nabii, mwalimu, au muinjilisti. Hata hivyo, kwa kuwa mtoto wa Mfalme, tumepatiwa zawadi na Yeye, kufanya kazi Yake, kwa nguvu Zake. Kutambua kwanza kabisa ni nani tuko ndani ya Kristo kutatuhifadhi katika nafasi nzuri ya unyenyekevu, lakini kama utambulisho wetu wa msingi ni “zawadi hii niliyo nayo,” ninadhani itakuwa vigumu kutoanguka katika kiburi na hivyo kujifungua kwa mabaya mengi na hatari.

Zawadi za Kiroho Zimetolewa na Mungu, Sio Kutafutwa na Mwanadamu

Je, kuna tahadhari inayopewa jinsi tunavyotafuta zawadi hii? Inamaanisha nini maneno ya Maandiko kwamba Mungu hutoa zawadi kulingana na mapenzi Yake? Kwa mfano, “Mungu pia akiwashuhudia pamoja na ishara na maajabu, na mataji mbalimbali ya miujiza, na zawadi za Roho Mtakatifu, kama anavyojitakia?” – Waebrania 2:4. Au, “Lakini yote haya hufanywa na Roho mmoja na huo huo, akigawanya kwa kila mtu kwa njia yake mwenyewe ?” – 1 Wakorintho 12:11.

Je, unaona katika mistari yote miwili HIARI ya Mungu ikihusika sana katika utoaji wa zawadi katika Kanisa? Labda “kutafuta zawadi za kiroho” kunapaswa kufanyika kwa siri kwangu nikitafuta Mungu afianye mimi niwe mnyenyekevu na anivishe na zawadi yoyote anayotaka kuniweka kuwa chombo chenye tija katika mwili wa kanisa niliyo sehemu yake—“Sio mapenzi yangu, bali yako yafanywe.” Labda Amenyenyekevu amenipatia zawadi ambayo sitaitambua wala kuitumia, na kile ninachohitaji ni kumchochea zawadi hiyo badala ya kuisahau, bali kuiitumia mahali ninapotumika kanisani. Je, inawezekana kwamba, ikiwa nitatafuta kwa nguvu zawadi nyingine ya kiroho, nadhani ningejiingizia bandia?

Pia, ni vizuri kusema mara nyingine moja kwa uwazi kwamba wakati kuna kutafuta kwa umakini zawadi za kiroho kawaida kuna matokeo mabaya. Wakati mwingine chache huondolewa na kufundishwa kuwa za kiroho zaidi, kama kuongea kwa lugha, miujiza, na uponyaji. Wengine watasisitiza kwamba hakuna au kuna thamani ndogo kabisa katika kufundisha zawadi za kiroho na kwamba zile pekee kwa siku zetu ni zile zinazohusu viongozi walioteuliwa wa kanisa kama utawala, wachungaji, na walimu. Wengine hutumia uelewa wao wa zawadi za kiroho kuwa watu wa kibinafsi na kuona thamani ndogo ya kuwa sehemu ya mwili. Hii ni makosa, kwa kuwa kusoma kwa uangalifu Maandiko haya kunatuonyesha kwamba ZAWADI ZOTE ni muhimu ili Mungu aweze kutumia zawadi zote kwa ushirikiano wa watu wote. Inawezekana kwamba pale ambapo zawadi fulani zinapoinuliwa juu ya nyingine, iwe kuongea kwa lugha, uponyaji, na miujiza; au iwe uinjilisti; au iwe zile zinazofaa zaidi kwa walioteuliwa kati yetu, kuna uwezekano kuwa kuna kipengele cha kiburi ambacho hakitambuliki miongoni mwetu? Tuko dhaifu sana kwa kukata tamaa hivyo ni vizuri kuchunguza mioyo yetu kwa kina tunapotafuta zawadi za kiroho.

Zawadi za Kiroho Hazipo Kati ya Orodha ya Sifa za Kiongozi wa Kanisa Katika Bibiliya

Paulo alisema kwa Timoti, UsipendeZaye zawadi uliyonayo, iliyo kwako kwa unabii, kwa kuteuliwa kwa mikono ya wajumbe – 1 Timoti 4:14. Labda badala ya kutafuta zawadi, tunahitaji kuacha kuacha zawadi iliyotolewa kwetu. Badala ya kutafuta kitu kipya na cha kusisimua, tunapaswa kuchochea zawadi tuliyonayo. Imetokea kwamba wanaume katika uongozi waliotolewa waliondolewa katika cheo chao kwa sababu hawakuwa na zawadi kwa kile walichoteuliwa. Nitakuwa mvivu sana na mwenye sala kabla ya kumtoa ndugu aliyeteuliwa kwa sababu hiyo. Je, si bora kumuombea Mungu ampatie zaidi zawadi ile iliyokiwekwa kwake kwa kuwekwa kwa mikono? Kukubali haraka kwamba hana zawadi inaweza kuwa njia rahisi tu ya kutokuwepo kwa matatizo.

Tusingefanya hivyo katika ndoa. Mara ngapi imekawa mke alikuwa na zawadi zaidi za uongozi kuliko mumewe? Kukatisha ndoa sio chaguo, wala si chaguo kuongeza mtu wa tatu kwenye muungano wa ndoa ili kuleta usawa wa kutendekezwa kwa zawadi zinazosemwa kushukiwa. Mara nyingi tumeona kuwa wakati sala na Roho Mtakatifu zilihusika katika hali kama hii, Mungu alimpa mume zawadi aliyoikosa (1 Wakorintho 12:24-25), na mke alijifunza kumpa nafasi zawadi yake kwa njia iliyomruhusu mume kuwa kichwa mwenye utu wa moyo wa nyumbani.

Mungu pia anaweza kumpa zawadi inayohitajika wale walioko katika ndoa kama hiyo na katika timu ya huduma kama hao wakigundua wanakosa. Kwa sehemu zetu nzuri hakuna uhitaji: lakini Mungu amechanganya mwili pamoja, akiwa amempa heshima zaidi sehemu ile iliokuwa inakosa: Iwe si kuwa na mfarakano [mgawanyiko] katika mwili; lakini wanachama wawe na uzito ule ule kwa kila mmoja – 1 Wakorintho 12:24-25. Je, kuna wakati wa kumtoa mtu kutoka ofisini kwa sababu ya ukosefu wa zawadi? Labda ndio, lakini tuwe wa tahadhari, polepole, waangalifu, na wa sala.

Katika kesi ya ugumu wa kanisa unaoonekana kusababishwa na ukosefu wa zawadi miongoni mwa walioteuliwa, tunahitaji kuzingatia mistari ifuatayo. “Ni nani mwenye busara na aliyezaliwa kwa maarifa miongoni mwenu? Aonyesha kutoka katika maadili mazuri matendo yake kwa unyenyekevu wa hekima. Lakini mkionao hasira kali na uvivu katika mioyo yenu, msijivunie, wala msidanganye dhidi ya ukweli. Hekima hii haitokani kutoka juu, bali ni ya kidunia, ya mwana mwili, ya shetani. Kwa maana palipo hasira na uvivu hapo kuna kuchanganyikiwa na kila tendo baya. Lakini hekima inayo toka juu ni kwanza takatifu, halafu yenye amani, nyororo, na rahisi kuombewa, iliyojaa rehema na matunda mema, bila upendeleo, na bila uwongo wa kidini. Na tunda la haki linaepukuliwa katika amani kwa wale wanaowatia amani.” – Yakobo 3:13-18. Kesi ya matatizo ya kanisa inayohusu uongozi wa kanisa ni adimu sana isiyohusisha ukosefu mkubwa wa mmoja au zaidi wa walioteuliwa kuishi kwa utimilifu mapenzi ya Mungu na hekima kama ilivyoelezwa hapa.

Jibu la kibiblia la kutatua matatizo ya kanisa yanayohusisha viongozi wa kanisa ni la hatua tatu. (1a) Viongozi waliohusika lazima wanyenyeke mioyo yao kwa toba mbele za Mungu na Neno lake, mbele ya walio teuliwa wengine, na pale inapobidi mbele ya kanisa la mahali. (1b) Ikiwa hali imeharibika sana, basi busara ya wakfu wa nje inapaswa kutafutwa. (2) Viongozi ambao wanaweza kukosa katika zawadi maalum wanapaswa kumtafuta Mungu kwa sala za moto, binafsi na za kanisa la mahali, na wanapaswa kumtafuta Mungu azijaze uwezo kupitia …kuteuliwa kwa mikono ya wajumbe – 1 Timoti 4:14. (3) Kisha BAADA ya utulivu kurejeshwa, ndugu wa mahali wako katika nafasi nzuri ya kumtafuta pamoja mapenzi ya Mungu kuhusu kumteuwa ndugu mwingine ili kusaidia.

Lengo la Mungu kwa Zawadi za Kiroho

Nitaona sababu kuu mbili za zawadi za Roho kutolewa kwa Kanisa.

Sababu ya kwanza ni kwa ajili ya faida ya kanisa. Katika Waefeso tunasoma: “na yeye aliwapa… [zawadi mbalimbali za kiroho kwa waumini] [kwa wengine zawadi hii na kwa wengine zawadi tofauti]… Kwa ajili ya ukamilishaji wa watakatifu, kwa ajili ya kazi ya huduma, kwa ajili ya kujenga mwili wa Kristo” – Waefeso 4:11-12. Sura ya 12 ya 1 Wakorintho ina mazungumzo marefu juu ya jinsi zawadi zinavyopaswa kutumika ili kuleta faida kwa mwili wa Kristo (kanisa la mahali) na katika aya ya 25 hasa, kwamba msifanyike mfarakano katika mwili, lakini wanachama wawe na uzito ule ule kwa kila mmoja.

Kuna wale wanaokwenda kuhubiri haja ya kuwa na zawadi za kiroho, wakihimiza zawadi maalum kama uinjilisti, uponyaji, miujiza, na lugha, na inavyoonekana katika kesi nyingi kuwa mafundisho haya ya mkazo hasa husababisha mgawanyiko badala ya umoja. Biblia inasema kwamba zawadi zilitolewa kuwaleta Wale wa Kanisa pamoja na ikiwa hazifanyi hivyo, tunapaswa kufikiria kama ni halisi au ni bandia. Natambua mgawanyiko hutokea kwa sababu nyingi, lakini ikiwa zawadi katika mwili hazileti umoja bali kugawa, ni bora tumtafute Mungu kwa majibu kwa nini, kwa sababu zawadi zilitolewa kuleta umoja, muunganiko, na ujenzi.

Sababu ya pili ni kwa ajili ya faida ya asiyeamini. Zawadi baadhi zilitolewa kama ishara kwa asiyeamini. “Kwa hiyo lugha ni ishara, si kwa waamini, bali kwa wale wasiowaamini; lakini unabii hauwafai wale wasiowaamini, bali kwa wale wanaoamini” – 1 Wakorintho 14:22. Tunaona katika Agano Jipya kwamba lugha, miujiza na uponyaji vilifuata injili mahali ambapo ilitangazwa kwa wale ambao hawajawahi kusikia kabla. Hii ilikuwa njia ambayo Mungu alitumia kuthibitisha na kuimarisha katika mioyo na akili za asiyeamini kwamba injili hii lazima iwe ya Mungu kwa sababu ya matukio ya ajabu. Tunaona pia kwamba lugha ziliifuata ueneaji wa injili ili wote wasikilize kwa lugha yao kama siku ya Pentekoste.

Ni ya kuvutia kwamba kati ya zawadi 19 tunazozitazama, nyingi zitakuwa zikitumika vyema zaidi katika Kanisa la mahali. Kumbuka, Mungu anatumia kanisa kufikia ulimwengu. Baadhi ya zawadi zilizotolewa kwa kanisa ni kwa kufikia ulimwengu, kwa mfano, uinjilisti ana wito maalum zaidi kufikia ulimwengu. Zawadi kama uponyaji, miujiza, na kuongea kwa lugha ni baadhi ya zawadi zinazojitokeza zaidi mbele za injili. Hii si kusema kwamba zawadi hizi hazionekani kabisa katika kanisa la mahali. Sala yangu ni kwamba ikiwa mtu angekuja katika huduma zetu ambaye hasemi neno la Kiingereza, na hakuna mtu wa kutafsiri mafundisho ya Neno katika lugha yao, basi Mungu atupatie zawadi za lugha ili waone injili na wajengeke.

Tumeona pale palipokuwa na ugonjwa, wazee wa kanisa walipotumwa na kulikuwa kwa mafuta na sala. Wakati mwingine Mungu alichagua kuponya kwa muujiza. Hata hivyo, kwa sababu sisi (waumini) tuna zawadi hii nzuri ya uponyaji sio lazima iwe Mungu anataka sisi wote tuponywe kila ugonjwa. Mtume Paulo alisali mara tatu kuponywa kutokana na ugonjwa wake wa kurudiwa (2 Wakorintho 12:7-12), lakini Mungu akamwambia hapana. Ikiwa hakuponywa wakati alipoponya wengine wengi, kwanini nadhani inapaswa kuwa tofauti kwa mimi? Hivyo ndivyo ilivyo kwa zawadi zote zinazotolewa kwa kanisa; zinaruhusiwa kutumika kwa mapenzi ya Mungu, si ya sisi. Ni muhimu kabisa kwangu na kwako kuwa sehemu ya mwili wa mahali ili tutakuwa na zawadi za Roho zikitumika pamoja kupitia wanachama wote, kwa kazi ya kanisa, kuleta umoja, muunganiko, na ujenzi, na kwa kazi inayoendelea ya Kanisa kwa kuita watu kutoka katika ulimwengu wa dhambi na kuwaalika katika ufalme Wake.

Zawadi ya Lugha

Ni muhimu kuzingatia kwa muda zawadi ya kiroho ya lugha na hasa nafasi yake katika Ufalme wa Mungu. Mtume Paulo anatueleza kuwa zimetolewa kama ishara. “Kwa hiyo lugha ni ishara, si kwa waamini, bali kwa wale wasiowaamini; lakini unabii hauwafai wale wasiowaamini, bali kwa wale wanaoamini” – 1 Wakorintho 14:22.

Sio ishara kwa mwamini kwamba kwa kweli ana Roho Mtakatifu, bali ni ishara kwa asiyeamini kwamba ujumbe wa injili ni halisi. Mfano wa kihistoria ulikuwa siku ya Pentekoste. Hatuamua uaminifu wa Petro kwa sababu aliongea kwa lugha nyingine. Sote tutakubali bila shaka kwamba Petro alikuwa kuzaliwa upya, na kwamba lugha mbalimbali hazikuwa kwa ajili ya idhini yake bali ili wale waliokuwa wakisikiliza wajue kwamba kuongea kwa lugha nyingi ilikuwa ya kimataifa. Ingekuwa ngumu kwa moyo mgumu kupuuza ujumbe uliotangazwa siku hiyo.

Hivi karibuni, nilifahamishwa kuhusu tafiti zilizofanywa kwa kurekodi maneno yasiyoeleweka ambayo yanafanana na kile kinachoitwa lugha leo. Cha kuvutia, waligundua kuwa wazungumzaji wa Kiingereza walitumia silabi za Kiingereza kwa kurudia, na kwamba wazungumzaji wa Kihispania walitumia silabi za Kihispania, hivyo walihitimisha kwamba mengi ya kile kinachoitwa lugha leo ni bandia ambacho mtu, kwa lugha yake mwenyewe, anarudia silabi za kienyeji kwa kurudia. Ninaamini katika kesi nyingi hufanywa bila kukusudia kwa sababu ya wingi wa udanganyifu unaofuata kuongea kwa lugha.

Kile ninachokiuelewa kama kitu cha kweli ni mfano wa mwanamke mmoja Canada, ambaye alijua tu Kifaransa na hakuwa na uelewa wa Kiingereza. Mwanamke huyu alikuja kwenye mkutano wa maboresho ambapo mwenehuruma alikuwa akihubiri kwa Kiingereza bila mfasiri wa Kifaransa. Alijibu kwa toba kwa ujumbe na wale waliomwongoza walimuuliza alivyosikia jinsi ujumbe ulivyokuwa kwa Kiingereza. Alijibu kwamba alisikia ilisemwa kwa Kifaransa kizuri zaidi alichowahi kusikia. Bila shaka muujiza ulifanyika ili asikie ujumbe wa wokozi na aweze kuyajibu. Nina hakika ilikuwa ya kupongezwa kujua jinsi ilivyokuwa ya kimuanadamu kwamba alikuwa na uwezo wa kusikia. Ninadhani kuna uwezekano mzuri kwamba wakati mwingine, yeye aliyekuwa anazungumza kwa lugha hata hakuwa na ufahamu wake. Hakika, kama Mungu alikuwa akimuumiza lugha wale waliokubaliana katika ujenzi wa Mnara wa Babel, Anaweza pia kusababisha maneno ya mwenehuruma wa Kiingereza kubadilika kuwa maneno ya Kifaransa kabla hayajatimia masikioni ya msikilizaji wa Kifaransa.

Sababu tunazoona katika maandiko kwa zawadi ya kuongea kwa lugha ni mbili, na ni kwa ajili ya asiyeamini anayekuja kati yetu. Sababu ya kwanza ni ili asingazwe ujumbe wa injili kwa lugha yake mwenyewe. Sababu ya pili ni kwamba anaposikia kwa njia ya muujiza kwa lugha yake mwenyewe na yule anayeongea hajui lugha yake, ni ishara kwa asiyeamini kumfanya atambue kwamba ujumbe anayesikia ni wa Mungu, na kwa Mungu.

Kwa kumalizia, tunagundua kwamba sababu kuu mbili za Mungu kutoa zawadi kwa kanisa, akiziwanikiza kwa kila mtu kama anavyotaka, ni kwa ajili ya umoja na ujenzi wa mwili wa Kristo, na kwa ajili ya asiyeamini asikilize na kuvutiwa na ujumbe wa injili. Tuchukue kwa uzito ikiwa zawadi za kiroho tulizonazo na zile ambazo zinaonekana katika makanisa yetu zinafanya kazi kwa madhumuni yaliyotolewa.
