Αυτός ο ύμνος θεωρείται γενικά ένας από τους πιο αγαπημένους ύμνους που γράφτηκαν κατά το τελευταίο μέρος του 19ου αιώνα. Η συγγραφή αυτού του στοχαστικού και όμορφα δομημένου κειμένου είναι ακόμη πιο αξιοσημείωτη αν λάβουμε υπόψη ότι ο συγγραφέας του ήταν σχεδόν εντελώς τυφλός και περιγράφει τη συγγραφή αυτού του ύμνου ως «καρπό πολλής πνευματικής οδύνης» και «το πιο γρήγορο κομμάτι δουλειάς που έχω κάνει ποτέ στη ζωή μου.»

Γεννημένος στη Γλασκώβη της Σκωτίας, στις 27 Μαρτίου 1842, ο George Matheson είχε μόνο μερική όραση ως παιδί και, αφού εισήλθε στο Πανεπιστήμιο της Γλασκώβης, η όρασή του συνέχισε να χειροτερεύει γρήγορα. Εκτός από «στιγμές σκιώδους όρασης», ήταν εντελώς τυφλός σε ηλικία 18 ετών. Αυτή η δοκιμασία της τύφλωσης φαινόταν καταστροφική αφού ήταν πρόθυμος και αδηφάγος μελετητής, ωστόσο τον οδήγησε να εμπιστευθεί τον Κύριο και ενίσχυσε τον πνευματικό του βίο.

Εισήλθε στο πανεπιστήμιο σε νεαρή ηλικία 15 ετών και αποφοίτησε με άριστα το 1861 σε ηλικία 19 ετών. Ήταν λαμπρός μαθητής, περνώντας ακόμη τέσσερα χρόνια μετά την αποφοίτηση σε περαιτέρω θεολογικές σπουδές, παραμένοντας την ίδια περίοδο άγαμος. Μετά την αποφοίτησή του έγινε εντελώς εξαρτημένος από άλλους, στηριζόμενος σε μεγάλο βαθμό στις δύο αδελφές του, οι οποίες ήταν τόσο αφοσιωμένες που έμαθαν λατινικά, ελληνικά και εβραϊκά καθώς νόμιζαν ότι αυτό θα μπορούσε να τον βοηθήσει στις θεολογικές του σπουδές. Η μία από αυτές συνέχισε να είναι η πιστή συνεργάτιδα και βοηθός του σε όλη του τη ζωή, υποβοηθώντας τον στο κήρυγμα και σε άλλα υπηρεσιακά καθήκοντα.

Μετά την ολοκλήρωση του θεολογικού του κύκλου, έγινε βοηθός ποιμένα στον διαπρεπή Δρ. Macduff, στην εκκλησία του οποίου με είχε αναθρέψει. Σύντομα, όμως, επιλέχθηκε υπηρετών ως κληρικός της Εκκλησίας της Σκωτίας στο παραθαλάσσιο θερινό θέρετρο Innellan. Εκεί παρέμεινε δεκαοκτώ χρόνια. Πολλές οικογένειες ερχόταν να περάσουν το καλοκαίρι κυρίως για να εμπνευσθούν από το κηρυγματικό του έργο.

Όποτε κήρυττε, η ανοικτή Βίβλος βρισκόταν μπροστά του καθώς στεκόταν στο άμβωνα, και για την εκκλησία έδειχνε να διαβάζει από αυτήν. Κατά τη διάρκεια των κηρυγμάτων, τα μάτια του έβλεπαν ευθεία προς την εκκλησία, και πολλοί έφευγαν χωρίς να έχουν την παραμικρή ιδέα ότι μόλις άκουσαν έναν τυφλό κήρυκα. Κατά την περίοδο αυτή συνήθιζε να απομνημονεύει τα κηρύγματά του, καθώς και τα χωρία της Γραφής που χρησιμοποιούσε στις ομιλίες του. Η μνήμη του ήταν τόσο κοφτερή που αν κάποιος του διαβάζε ένα από τα προετοιμασμένα κηρύγματά του δύο φορές, ή οτιδήποτε άλλο ήθελε να απομνημονεύσει, μπορούσε από τότε να το επαναλάβει τέλεια. Μια Κυριακή, όμως, μετά από αυτή τη συνήθεια για 12 χρόνια, στη μέση ενός δυνατού κηρύγματος η μνήμη του κατέρρευσε εντελώς και το θέμα στο οποίο κήρυττε εξαφανίστηκε από τη σκέψη του. Καθίστηκε και ζήτησε να ψαλεί ένας ψαλμός και, μετά το τραγούδι, με απόλυτη ηρεμία εξήγησε στο ακροατήριο τι είχε συμβεί. Μετά από αυτό στάθηκε, έδωσε ένα νέο κείμενο και κήρυξε ένα αυτοσχέδιο κήρυγμα μεγάλης δύναμης. Μετά από εκείνη την εμπειρία ο George έγραψε λίγα κηρύγματα και τελικά προετοίμαζε μόνο ένα περίγραμμα από το οποίο κήρυττε.

Η τελευταία ποιμαντορία του Δρ. Matheson άρχισε το 1886 σε ηλικία 44 ετών όταν έγινε πάστορας της μεγάλης ενορίας της St. Bernard’s στο Εδιμβούργο, όπου το εύγλωττο κήρυγμά του προσέλκυε σταθερά πλήθη ανθρώπων στις λειτουργίες. Εκεί παρέμεινε για 13 χρόνια, με την εκκλησία του να αυξάνεται από 1.494 μέλη σε 1.703 στα πρώτα 5 χρόνια. Συνέχισε πιστά να κηρύττει το ευαγγέλιο και έγινε ευρύτερα γνωστός ως ένας από τους διακεκριμένους κήρυκες και ποιμένες της Σκωτίας και ήταν πολύ εκτιμητός στο Εδιμβούργο όπου κατοικούσε.

Έχουν γίνει πολλές εικασίες σχετικά με την αιτία της ψυχικής δυσφορίας που ώθησε τον συγγραφέα να γράψει αυτό το κείμενο. Μια πολύ διαδεδομένη εξήγηση, αν και ποτέ μη επαληθευμένη, είναι ότι αυτό το κείμενο ήταν αποτέλεσμα της σκληρής δοκιμασίας που αντιμετώπισε ο Matheson αφού η μέλλουσα νύφη του τον εγκατέλειψε λίγο πριν από τον γάμο όταν έμαθε για την επικείμενη ολική τύφλωσή του. Αν και αυτή η ιστορία δεν μπορεί να τεκμηριωθεί, υπάρχουν πολλές σημαντικές νύξεις σε αυτόν τον ύμνο που αντανακλούν μια λυπημένη καρδιά, όπως η «φλεγμαίνουσα δάδα» και η «δανεική ακτίνα» στο δεύτερο στίχο, η ανίχνευση του «ουράνιου τόξου μέσα από τη βροχή» στην τρίτη στροφή, καθώς και ο «σταυρός» στον τελευταίο στίχο.

Ευτυχώς, ο Δρ. Matheson περιέγραψε ο ίδιος μια αφήγηση για τη συγγραφή αυτού του ύμνου:

«Ο ύμνος μου συντέθηκε στη μάνση του Innellan το βράδυ της 6ης Ιουνίου 1882. Ήμουν εκείνη την ώρα μόνος. Ήταν η μέρα του γάμου της αδελφής μου και τα υπόλοιπα μέλη της οικογένειας έμεναν για τη νύχτα στη Γλασκώβη. Κάτι συνέβη σε μένα, το οποίο ήταν γνωστό μόνο σε μένα, και το οποίο μου προκάλεσε την πιο έντονη πνευματική οδύνη. Ο ύμνος ήταν ο καρπός εκείνης της οδύνης και ήταν το πιο γρήγορο κομμάτι δουλειάς που έκανα ποτέ στη ζωή μου. Μια γνήσια έμπνευση, είχα περισσότερο την εντύπωση ότι μου υπαγορεύθηκε από κάποια εσωτερική φωνή παρά ότι το επεξεργάστηκα εγώ ο ίδιος. Είμαι απολύτως σίγουρος ότι όλο το έργο ολοκληρώθηκε σε πέντε λεπτά και εξίσου σίγουρος ότι ποτέ δεν υπέστη οποιαδήποτε επιμέλεια ή διόρθωση από μένα. Δεν έχω φυσικό χάρισμα ρυθμού. Όλοι οι άλλοι στίχοι που έχω γράψει είναι κατασκευασμένα προϊόντα· αυτός ήρθε σαν αυγή από τα ύψη. Δεν κατόρθωσα ποτέ να ξανακερδίσω την ίδια ζέση στο στίχο.»

Ο ύμνος εμφανίστηκε για πρώτη φορά στο μηνιαίο περιοδικό της Εκκλησίας της Σκωτίας, Life and Work, τον Ιανουάριο του 1883. Η μελωδία συντέθηκε ένα χρόνο αργότερα από έναν εξέχοντα σκωτσέζο οργανίστα της εποχής, τον Albert L. Peace, ο οποίος του ζητήθηκε να γράψει μια μελωδία ειδικά για το κείμενο του Matheson.

Η ίδιος ο Peace αφηγείται για τη σύνθεση αυτής της ωραίας μελωδίας ως εξής: «Αφού το διάβασα προσεκτικά, έγραψα τη μουσική αμέσως και μπορώ να πω ότι το μελάνι της πρώτης νότας μόλις είχε στεγνώσει όταν είχα τελειώσει τη μελωδία.» Η προέλευση ή το όνομα της μελωδίας, St. Margaret, είναι άγνωστα εκτός από το ότι είναι ένα όνομα πολύ σεβαστό στη Σκωτία, και βεβαίως λόγω της αγαπημένης βασίλισσας Margaret της Σκωτίας.

Τα τελευταία χρόνια της ζωής του Matheson, από την ηλικία των 57 έως τον θάνατό του σε ηλικία 64 ετών, αφιερώθηκαν στη συγγραφή κάποιων από τα καλύτερα πνευματικά κείμενα στην αγγλική γλώσσα, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των Moments on the Mount, Voice of the Spirit και Rests by the River. Αν και αυτός είναι ο μοναδικός του ύμνος που βρίσκεται στα περισσότερα υμνολόγια, έγραψε κι άλλους ωραίους ύμνους, συμπεριλαμβανομένων των «Make Me A Captive Lord» και «Then I Shall Be Free.»

Οι τέσσερις βασικές λέξεις του «O Love, That Wilt Not Let Me Go» είναι: αγάπη, φως, χαρά και σταυρός. Αυτές οι λέξεις έχουν περιγραφεί ως η πλήρης ικανοποίηση για κάθε πιστό του οποίου η ζωή είναι εντελώς παραδομένη στο θέλημα του Θεού. Μπορεί να χρειαστεί το υπόλοιπο της ζωής κάποιου για να ανακαλύψει πλήρως την προσωπική σημασία αυτών των τεσσάρων εκφράσεων.

I grew up in the same church setting in which my parents were born and raised. However, by the time I was 10, my parents began to be concerned with the direction the young folks were going and wanted something different for their children. So, my parents got in touch with a church from another state, which helped them make connections with a small church that was located close to where we lived.

I was more of a quiet, strong-willed child and was quickly turning into a rebellious teenager. My parents did all they knew to do with me at the time. One of which was making the move to this new church since it had more of a godly youth environment. I had a hard time with this change. At our old church, I had friends that were on the same page as me and supported me in my rebellious ways, but at the new church I was more of the “bad guy” and didn’t fit in with the other young people.

Over the course of time that church dissolved, and my parents decided to move to another state, closer to a more stable church. So it was, that, when I was 14, we spent our first night in a different state, in a different house, on a different road, and with different neighbors. We went shopping in a different town and went to a different church, with people that I barely knew. I didn’t like change. I found it challenging to meet new people and make new friends. I struggled majorly with all these changes, so, I never bothered trying to plug in and be an active part in our new life. Instead, I slowly built walls around my life and heart, all the while growing colder and more rebellious.

As I grew older and harder, my parents tried to work with me, but I would have nothing to do with it. I eventually got a job and was introduced to country music and other worldly things. Since I enjoy work, I poured myself into it and worked long hours. That way I wouldn’t need to be around the family or church people, and I wouldn’t need to go to church activities. Thus, I became more removed and isolated from those around me.

The church people didn’t know how to relate to me; most of them just left me to myself. Deep down I was desperately longing for love and acceptance from my family and church. This caused me to spiral downward. I continued to stuff my feelings and build a wall around myself, all the while hardening my heart further. As time went on, I withdrew more and more from my family and the church. I felt more and more like a social misfit that no one knew what to do with. I decided I was going to run away and live my own life.

Somehow my parents got wind of this idea and tried to do all that they knew to do to help me, but I resented it. Looking back, I know without a doubt that they were doing it out of love and care, but there was a great lack in our relationship. Thus, I continued to grow harder and colder.

The summer I was 17, a visiting minister (‘Mike’) and his family came to our church for meetings. I knew them from years before and somehow through our interaction during the meetings my heart started to soften and open. I’m not quite sure why, but for some reason, I decided that I wanted to go spend the winter with them. So, my parents got in contact with them, and it was decided that I could stay with them for a few months.

My plan was to spend a few months away from everything and then I would return home when I was almost 18. Once I was 18, I was planning to leave home and do my own thing. I was certain no one could stop me because I would be of legal age. However, God obviously had different plans...

Somehow ‘Mike’ convinced me to go to along to a week of meetings in another state. While we were there, I don’t remember that the conviction was any stronger than any other time. However, one evening after the service he asked me if I wanted to become a Christian and have my sins forgiven. I don’t remember what I told him, but we talked for a while. He took me through the Bible, helping me to see what God says about it all; then we prayed. When we got up from praying, I can’t say that something major happened, but it was definitely the night that I found salvation! That night, something changed in my heart. I knew that I now wanted to do things God’s way. I knew that my end goal in life was to run the race well and to finish victoriously. That is what has helped me through the years.

On July 31, 2011, I was baptized upon the confession of my faith. The next number of years were definitely not easy. I would even say that at times it seemed to have been harder than in the years before my conversion. Out of respect to others, I don’t feel I can share everything that has happened over the years, but I will try to share several main points. You can imagine that with the walls I had built around myself and the comfort I had found in this, that the years following my conversion were full of ups and downs as I tried to relearn how to relate to other believers and to people in general.

Even though I had reached out to God for forgiveness of my sins and had committed my life to following Him, I had many old habits of relating to others in wrong ways that still needed to be sanctified. Things at home continued to improve but there was still room for progress, which added to the stress. As the years went by, my stress level continued to rise. I didn’t know what to do with it, so I resorted to taking high doses of NoDoz® with an energy drink before I went to bed, trying to get my nerves to relax enough so I could sleep (don’t try this at home, it is dangerous). The next day I would get up and face it all again. One year for most of the year I struggled with thoughts of not wanting to continue on with life. During this time, I had a very close friend who gave me much encouragement. I believe that the regular contact I had with this close friend, the prayers of others, and God’s faithfulness all working together kept me from doing something that I would have later regretted.

I had another close friend who had also gone through a lot but seemed to be finding God’s answers to life’s struggles. We would go out for supper, spending time together talking about life’s struggles. I remember times that I would leave his car and tears would be streaming down his face because he wasn’t sure if I was going to make it. Then he went to the mission field for two years to teach English.

I’m not sure what all was going on in his life but one day we got word that he was missing. Eventually we heard from him; he was okay and was living back in the states again. My heart was torn… One of the few friends that I had, had now turned his back on what he had once believed and on that which he had once tried to convince me of. Yet here I was, still struggling… Why not just give up fighting…? Why not just go live the easy life…? As time went on, I continued to long for love and acceptance. At times the struggle, the aching, and the longing seemed almost unbearable. But I knew deep down that giving up was not what I wanted. It would not get the end result that I wanted. Once more through the encouragement and regular contact with my close friend, the prayers of others, and God’s faithfulness, I continued to press on.

Another young man started taking an interest in my life and we eventually became close friends. He and his wife were a great encouragement to me. Then due to some disagreements with the church, they became dissatisfied and left the church. They threw aside a lot of what they had once stood for. So here I was once again with a close friend that had turned his back on what he had once stood for. What’s the use? Why does life need to be so hard? Maybe I should also give up… But I didn’t want to totally throw God out. Maybe I could find a church that was less strict. Once again, I came to my senses and realized that’s not really what I wanted. That direction wouldn’t take me where I wanted to go. So once more through the encouragement and regular contact with my close friend, the prayers of others, and God’s faithfulness, I continued to press on. At the time it was tough, but looking back, I see I have learned a lot by all I have gone through.

In the fall of 2015, I went to Washington state due to a work opportunity. At the time I went, there were things going on at my home church that I was struggling with. Because of all the stress that I was facing, I was feeling quite discouraged about Church life, Christianity, and life in general. I wasn’t wanting to throw my Christianity away, but I was wondering, “Is this really what it’s all about?” “Why can’t people just get along?” Is this really what God had in mind for His people? If we are “little Christs” like we claim to be, shouldn’t we be able to get along? Shouldn’t we be the ones that are joyful and full of life?

I went to Washington with these kinds of thoughts on my mind. While there, I attended a church that was both Biblical and spiritually minded. It’s hard to explain all that went on in my mind, heart, and life during those six months. But I left there and went back home with a renewed strength and vision.

We should be the light of the world! We should have something to offer others! We should be able to get along with one another! Yes, we do go through hard times individually and collectively as a church, but if we fight the good fight of faith, if we finish our course, if we keep the faith, there is laid up for each of us a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only but unto all them also that love his appearing. I have fought a good fight, I have finished my course, I have kept the faith: Henceforth there is laid up for me a crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, shall give me at that day: and not to me only, but unto all them also that love his appearing –2 Timothy 4:7-8.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

June 15, 2018, at 4:40 pm. the scream of the emergency services’ pager split the peaceful afternoon as it crackled to life. “One-car rollover on ‘Gingko Avenue’, possible entrapment,” was the repeated dispatch. As we walked onto the scene, there sat a young girl who appeared to be in her mid-twenties and was visibly banged up. With blood and tears streaming down her face, she repeated these phrases, “I don’t want to die… I’m not ready to die… I may never see my baby again.” As seconds turned to minutes, the paramedics tried to calm her anxious nerves. We searched the mangled car and surrounding area for the supposed missing baby. All the while she sat there with lines of worry and fear. She had tears and blood streaming down her face, as she repeated, “I may never see my baby again… I don’t want to die… I’m not ready to die.”

As first responders, all we found was a car seat that wasn’t fastened in, with no evidence of a baby anywhere. As the ambulance crew strapped her to the stretcher and loaded her in the ambulance, she was still repeating, “Where’s my baby…? I’m not ready to die… I don’t want to die… I may never see my baby again.”

As I left the scene that evening, with that image and those phrases running through my mind, I was struck with two sober thoughts. If that was me, miraculously surviving an accident and sitting there beside my vehicle, barely coherent, with blood streaming down my face, what would I be saying? What would the paramedics and rescue team remember me by? Would I be ready to die? Would I be clear before God?

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

As Christians, when is the last time we helped someone prepare their soul for death? As believers who have been redeemed from the misery and chaos of a life of sin (see 1 Corinthians 6:9-11), we should …be ready always to give an answer to every man that asketh [us] you a reason of the hope that is in [us] you with meekness and fear: –1 Peter 3:15.

In the fall of 2018, God opened the door for me to move to a church in a different state where I have found stability. It was here that God brought a godly young lady into my life, and we were married on November 30, 2019. Being married and having brothers who surrounded me with discipleship, compassion, and prayerful support helped me to grow in the Lord in many ways.

Being here has awakened within me a renewed vision to be the light of the world. Today, I am thankful that God did not let me go. As I kept fighting the spiritual fight, God kept giving me the strength and wisdom to do the next right thing. With each victory, my strength has grown stronger. Draw nigh to God, and he will draw nigh to you… –James 4:8. I thank God for giving me victory and for helping me find my ultimate source of love, security, and purpose—my Lord and Saviour, Jesus Christ.

나는 부모님이 태어나고 자란 동일한 교회 환경에서 자랐다. 그러나 내가 10살쯤 되었을 때, 부모님은 젊은이들이 가는 방향에 대해 걱정하기 시작하셨고 자녀들에게는 다른 것을 바라셨다. 그래서 부모님은 다른 주에 있는 한 교회와 연락을 취하셨고, 그 교회는 우리 집 근처에 있던 작은 교회와 연결되도록 도와주었다.

나는 조용하고 완고한 아이였고 빠르게 반항적인 십대로 변해가고 있었다. 부모님은 당시 할 수 있는 모든 것을 나에게 시도하셨다. 그중 하나가 더 경건한 청년 환경이 있는 그 새 교회로 이사하는 것이었다. 나는 이 변화에 힘들어했다. 이전 교회에서는 나와 생각이 같고 내 반항적인 태도를 지지해 주는 친구들이 있었지만, 새 교회에서는 내가 더 ‘문제아’였고 다른 젊은이들과 어울리지 못했다.

시간이 흐르면서 그 교회는 해산되었고 부모님은 더 안정된 교회에 가까운 다른 주로 이사하기로 결정하셨다. 그렇게 해서 내가 14살 때 우리는 다른 주의 다른 집, 다른 길, 다른 이웃들과 함께 첫날 밤을 보냈다. 우리는 다른 마을에서 쇼핑을 했고 거의 알지 못하는 사람들과 함께 다른 교회에 갔다. 나는 변화를 좋아하지 않았다. 새로운 사람을 만나고 새 친구를 사귀는 것이 힘들었다. 나는 이런 모든 변화로 크게 고통받았고, 새 삶에 적극적으로 참여하려고 애쓰지 않았다. 대신 나는 천천히 내 삶과 마음 주위에 벽을 쌓았고, 그 사이 점점 더 냉담하고 반항적으로 변해갔다.

내가 나이가 들고 마음이 더 굳어질수록 부모님은 나를 돕기 위해 애쓰셨지만 나는 전혀 받아들이지 않았다. 결국 나는 직장을 구했고 컨트리 음악과 다른 세상적인 것들을 접하게 되었다. 나는 일하는 것을 좋아했기 때문에 일에 몰두했고 긴 시간을 일했다. 그렇게 하면 가족이나 교회 사람들 곁에 있을 필요가 없고 교회 활동에 나갈 필요도 없었다. 그래서 나는 주변 사람들로부터 더 멀어지고 고립되었다.

교회 사람들은 나와 어떻게 관계를 맺어야 할지 몰랐다; 대부분은 나를 내버려 두었다. 속마음 깊은 곳에서는 나는 가족과 교회로부터 사랑과 수용을 간절히 바라고 있었다. 이것이 나를 점점 추락하게 만들었다. 나는 계속해서 내 감정을 억누르고 나 자신 주위에 벽을 쌓았고, 그 동안 내 마음은 더 단단해졌다. 시간이 지날수록 나는 가족과 교회로부터 점점 더 물러났다. 나는 점점 더 아무도 어떻게 해야 할지 모르는 사회적 부적응자로 느꼈다. 나는 도망가서 내 멋대로 살기로 결심했다.

어떻게든 부모님은 이 생각을 눈치채셨고 나를 돕기 위해 아시던 모든 것을 시도하셨지만 나는 그것을 원망했다. 되돌아보면 분명히 그들이 사랑과 보살핌으로 그렇게 하셨다는 것을 의심치 않지만, 우리 관계에는 큰 결핍이 있었다. 그래서 나는 계속 더 완고하고 더 냉담해졌다.

내가 17살이던 여름, 방문 목사(‘마이크’)와 그의 가족이 회중을 위해 우리 교회에 오셨다. 나는 그들을 예전부터 알고 있었고 회중 모임 중 우리의 상호 작용을 통해 내 마음이 부드러워지고 열리기 시작했다. 정확히 왜 그런지는 모르겠지만, 나는 그들과 겨울을 함께 보내고 싶다고 결심했다. 그래서 부모님은 그들과 연락을 취했고 내가 몇 달 동안 그들과 지낼 수 있도록 결정되었다.

내 계획은 몇 달 동안 모든 것에서 떨어져 지내다가 거의 18살이 되었을 때 집으로 돌아오는 것이었다. 18살이 되면 집을 떠나 내 방식대로 살 계획이었다. 합법적인 성인이 되면 아무도 나를 막을 수 없을 거라고 확신했다. 그러나 하나님은 분명히 다른 계획을 갖고 계셨다...

어떻게든 ‘마이크’는 나를 설득해 다른 주의 일주일 모임에 함께 가게 했다. 그곳에 있는 동안, 내가 기억하기로는 다른 때보다 더 강한 회개의 감정이 들었던 것은 아니었다. 그러나 어느 저녁 예배 후 그는 내게 내가 그리스도인이 되어 내 죄가 사해지기를 원하느냐고 물었다. 내가 그에게 뭐라고 말했는지는 기억나지 않지만 우리는 한동안 이야기했다. 그는 성경을 통해 하나님께서 이 모든 일에 대해 무엇이라고 말씀하시는지 보게 도와주었고; 그다음 우리는 기도했다. 기도에서 일어났을 때, 무슨 엄청난 일이 일어났다고는 말할 수 없지만, 분명히 그날 밤 나는 구원을 얻은 밤이었다! 그날 밤 내 마음에 무언가가 변했다. 나는 이제 하나님의 방법으로 살기를 원한다는 것을 알았다. 내 인생의 궁극적 목표는 경주를 잘 달려 승리로 마치는 것이라는 것을 알았다. 그 목표가 수년 동안 나를 도운 것이다.

2011년 7월 31일, 나는 믿음의 고백 위에 침례를 받았다. 그 다음 몇 년은 분명히 쉽지 않았다. 때로는 회심 이전의 시절보다 더 힘들게 느껴졌다고도 말할 수 있다. 타인을 배려하여, 지난 수년간 일어난 모든 일을 다 이야기할 수는 없지만 몇 가지 주요 사항을 나누려 한다. 내가 쌓아온 벽과 그 안에서 찾은 편안함 때문에 회심 이후의 해들은 다른 신자들과, 그리고 일반 사람들과 관계를 다시 배우려 애쓰는 가운데 기복이 많았을 것이라 상상할 수 있을 것이다.

비록 내가 내 죄에 대한 용서를 위해 하나님께 나아가 내 삶을 그분께 맡겼지만, 타인과 관계를 맺는 옛 습관들 중 아직 성화되어야 할 많은 것들이 남아 있었다. 집안 상황은 계속 좋아졌지만 여전히 진전의 여지가 있었고, 그것이 스트레스를 더했다. 세월이 흐르면서 내 스트레스 수준은 계속 증가했다. 나는 그것을 어떻게 처리해야 할지 몰랐고, 그래서 잠자리에 들기 전 높은 복용량의 NoDoz®와 에너지 음료를 함께 섭취하여 신경을 이완시켜 잠을 청하려 했다(집에서 따라 해서는 안 된다, 위험하다). 다음 날 나는 다시 일어나 모든 것을 마주했다. 어느 해 대부분의 기간 동안 나는 삶을 계속하고 싶지 않다는 생각으로 고통받았다. 그 시기에 매우 가까운 친구가 있어 많은 격려를 주었다. 나는 이 가까운 친구와의 정기적인 접촉, 다른 이들의 기도, 그리고 하나님의 신실하심이 함께 작용하여 내가 나중에 후회할 일을 하지 않게 지켜 주었다고 믿는다.

또 다른 친한 친구가 있었는데 그도 많은 고난을 겪었으나 삶의 문제에 대한 하나님의 답을 찾아가는 것 같았다. 우리는 저녁을 같이 하며 삶의 고난에 대해 이야기하곤 했다. 그의 차에서 내리면 눈물이 그렁그렁한 얼굴로 내가 살아남을지 걱정하던 때를 기억한다. 그 후 그는 영어를 가르치기 위해 2년 동안 선교지로 떠났다.

그의 삶에 무슨 일이 있었는지 잘 모르겠지만 어느 날 그는 실종되었다는 소식을 들었다. 결국 그로부터 소식을 들었고 그는 괜찮았으며 다시 미국에 돌아와 살고 있었다. 내 마음은 찢어졌다… 내가 가진 몇 안 되는 친구 중 한 명이, 한때 믿었던 것을, 한때 나에게 확신시키려 했던 것을 저버린 것이다. 그런데도 여기 나는 여전히 고군분투하고 있었다… 왜 싸움을 포기하지 않는가…? 왜 편한 삶으로 가버리지 않는가…? 시간이 흐르면서 나는 계속해서 사랑과 수용을 갈망했다. 때로는 싸움과 아픔과 갈망이 거의 견딜 수 없을 정도로 느껴졌다. 그러나 내 안 깊은 곳에서는 포기하고 싶은 것이 아니었다. 포기는 내가 원하던 최종 결과를 가져오지 못할 것이었다. 다시 한 번 가까운 친구와의 격려와 정기적인 접촉, 다른 이들의 기도, 그리고 하나님의 신실하심으로 나는 계속 전진할 수 있었다.

또 다른 젊은이가 내 삶에 관심을 갖기 시작했고 우리는 결국 친한 친구가 되었다. 그와 그의 아내는 나에게 큰 격려가 되었다. 그러나 교회와의 몇 가지 불화로 인해 그들은 불만을 품고 교회를 떠났다. 그들은 한때 자신들이 지키던 많은 것들을 버렸다. 그래서 나는 다시 한 번 한때 자신들이 지키던 것을 저버린 친한 친구를 보게 되었다. 무슨 소용이 있는가? 왜 삶은 이렇게 힘들어야 하는가? 아마 나도 포기해야 하나… 하지만 나는 하나님을 완전히 밀어내고 싶지 않았다. 아마 덜 엄격한 교회를 찾을 수 있을지도 모른다. 다시 정신을 차리고 나는 그것이 내가 진정으로 원하는 것이 아님을 깨달았다. 그런 방향은 내가 가고 싶은 곳으로 데려다주지 못할 것이다. 그래서 다시 한 번 가까운 친구와의 격려와 정기적인 접촉, 다른 이들의 기도, 그리고 하나님의 신실하심으로 나는 계속 전진했다. 당시에는 힘들었지만, 돌이켜보면 내가 겪은 모든 것을 통해 많은 것을 배웠음을 알겠다.

2015년 가을, 나는 일자리를 구하게 되어 워싱턴 주로 갔다. 내가 떠날 때 집 교회에서 내가 힘들어하던 일들이 진행 중이었다. 직면한 모든 스트레스 때문에 교회 생활과 기독교 신앙, 그리고 삶 전반에 대해 꽤 낙담하고 있었다. 나는 기독교 신앙을 버리고 싶지는 않았지만, “정말 이것이 전부인가?” “사람들은 왜 서로 화합하지 못하는가?” “이것이 정말 하나님께서 그분 백성을 위해 생각하신 바인가?” 하는 의문을 품었다. 우리가 주장하듯이 ‘작은 그리스도들’이라면, 우리가 서로 잘 지내지 못해서야 되겠는가? 우리가 기쁨과 생명으로 충만하지 않아야 하겠는가?

나는 이런 생각들을 안고 워싱턴에 갔다. 그곳에서 나는 성경적이고 영적으로 건전한 교회를 다녔다. 그 여섯 달 동안 내 마음과 삶과 생각에서 일어난 모든 것을 설명하기는 어렵다. 그러나 나는 그곳을 떠나 집으로 돌아올 때 새롭게 된 힘과 비전을 가지고 돌아왔다.

우리는 세상의 빛이 되어야 한다! 우리는 다른 이들에게 내어줄 것이 있어야 한다! 우리는 서로 잘 지낼 수 있어야 한다! 맞다, 우리는 개인적으로 그리고 교회로서 힘든 시기를 겪지만, 기쁨의 싸움을 싸우고 경주를 끝까지 달려 믿음을 지키면 각 사람을 위해 의의 면류관이 예비되어 있다. 주께서 의로운 심판자이시니 그 날에 내게 주실 것이요, 나뿐 아니라 그의 나타나심을 사랑하는 모든 자들에게도 주실 것이다. 내가 아름다운 싸움을 싸웠고, 경주를 마쳤으며, 믿음을 지켰다: 이로써 앞으로 나를 위하여 의의 면류관이 예비되어 있으니, 주 곧 의로운 심판자가 그 날에 나에게 주실 것이요, 나뿐 아니라 그의 나타나심을 사모하는 모든 자들에게도 줄 것이다—디모데후서 4:7-8.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

2018년 6월 15일, 오후 4시 40분. 응급 서비스 호출기가 평화로운 오후를 가르며 울렸다. “Gingko Avenue에서 1대 차량 전복, 매몰 가능성”이라는 반복되는 무전이었다. 우리가 현장에 걸어 나갔을 때, 이십대 중반으로 보이는 한 젊은 여성이 눈에 띄게 다친 채로 앉아 있었다. 피와 눈물이 얼굴을 타고 흐르며 그녀는 이런 말을 반복했다. “죽고 싶지 않아요… 죽을 준비가 안 됐어요… 아기를 다시 못 볼 수도 있어요.” 초가 분으로 흐르는 동안 구급대원들은 그녀의 불안한 신경을 달래려 애썼다. 우리는 망가진 차와 주변을 수색하여 실종된 것으로 추정되는 아기를 찾았다. 그동안 그녀는 걱정과 두려움의 주름을 지으며 앉아 있었다. 그녀는 눈물과 피를 흘리며 반복했다. “아기를 다시 못 볼지도 몰라요… 죽고 싶지 않아요… 죽을 준비가 안 됐어요.”

응급요원으로서 우리가 찾은 것은 고정되지 않은 카시트 하나뿐이었고, 어디에도 아기의 흔적은 없었다. 구급대원이 그녀를 들것에 고정시켜 구급차에 실었을 때도 그녀는 계속해서 “내 아기는 어디에요…? 죽을 준비가 안 됐어요… 죽고 싶지 않아요… 아기를 다시 못 볼지도 몰라요”라고 반복했다.

그날 밤 그 장면을 떠나오며 그 이미지와 문구들이 내 머릿속을 맴돌 때, 나는 두 가지 엄숙한 생각에 사로잡혔다. 만약 기적적으로 사고에서 살아남아 차량 옆에 앉아 거의 분별력을 잃은 채 피를 흘리며 서 있는 것이 나라면, 나는 무엇을 말하고 있을까? 구급대원들과 구조팀은 나를 무엇으로 기억할까? 나는 죽을 준비가 되어 있을까? 하나님 앞에서 분명할까?

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

그리스도인으로서 우리는 최근에 마지막을 준비하도록 누군가의 영혼을 도와준 적이 언제였는가? 죄의 비참함과 혼란에서 구속받은 신자로서(고린도전서 6:9-11 참조), 우리는 “너희 속에 있는 소망의 이유를 묻는 자에게는 항상 온유와 두려움으로 답변할 것을 준비하라” 해야 한다—베드로전서 3:15.

2018년 가을, 하나님은 내가 다른 주의 교회로 옮겨 안정성을 찾을 수 있는 문을 열어 주셨다. 그곳에서 하나님은 경건한 젊은 여성을 내 삶에 보내셨고 우리는 2019년 11월 30일에 결혼했다. 결혼하고 형제들로부터 제자훈련과 연민, 기도의 지원을 받으면서 나는 여러 면에서 주 안에서 성장할 수 있었다.

이곳에 있으면서 나는 세상의 빛이 되려는 새 비전을 되찾게 되었다. 오늘 나는 하나님이 나를 놓지 않으셨음에 감사한다. 영적 싸움을 계속 싸우는 동안 하나님은 내가 다음에 해야 할 옳은 일을 할 수 있는 힘과 지혜를 계속 주셨다. 각 승리로 내 힘은 더 강해졌다. “하나님께 가까이 하라 그리하면 그가 너희에게 가까이 하시리라…”—야고보서 4:8. 나는 승리를 주시고 나의 궁극적 사랑과 안전과 목적의 근원이신 나의 주요 구주 예수 그리스도를 찾도록 도와주신 하나님께 감사한다.

Greetings of brotherly love to one and all. The year 2022 is almost gone. A lot has happened. Another year of devastating storms, floods, fires, earthquakes, wars, and rumors of wars. America has gone through another season of political elections, causing the conservatives and liberals to become even more polarized into opposing parties.

Recently, I have been reflecting on the current status of life as a committed Bible-believing Christian in our world today. Sure, there are certain places in our world where Christians live in constant threat of imprisonment or death simply because they are trying to live according to God’s Word. However, the world, seems to be moving towards an increasingly negative perspective of God’s people. In an increasingly developing trend, there is a surprising rise of hostility towards the committed believer.

What is happening? I have had numerous conversations with various believers from around the country who seem to have a growing alarm about the current victorious march of evil over good, of liberal agendas over a conservative lifestyle, and the list goes on. Current skyrocketing inflation, the potential of unprecedented heating costs for many, the rumors of rising interest rates, and the ongoing shortage of goods all tend to cause a person to be jolted out of a sense of normality.

For us as Christians, let us always keep our focus fixed on the God of heaven. This is the God that Paul declared on Mars Hill—God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands; Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things; –Acts 17:24-25.

Let’s stop focusing on the fact that evil seems to be prevailing and increasing around us and then concluding that somehow Satan has the upper hand right now. Rather, let us be reminded about what God’s Word says. But evil men and seducers shall wax worse and worse, deceiving, and being deceived. But continue thou in the things which thou hast learned and hast been assured of, knowing of whom thou hast learned them; And that from a child thou hast known the holy scriptures, which are able to make thee wise unto salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus. All scripture is given by inspiration of God, and is profitable for doctrine, for reproof, for correction, for instruction in righteousness: That the man of God may be perfect, throughly furnished unto all good works –2 Timothy 3:13-17.

Let us keep our eyes fixed on Jesus …the author and finisher of our faith; who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising the shame, and is set down at the right hand of the throne of God –Hebrews 12:2. Instead of believing Satan’s lie that he is somehow winning the battle for Truth right now, let’s remember that the Bible reveals that Satan can do nothing without God allowing him a temporary free rein. It seemed to those looking on that Satan had the complete upper hand when Jesus was crucified and buried. Surprise, surprise! Satan had unwittingly allowed God to use him to accomplish everything that had been prophesied throughout the Scriptures. It is the same today… God will again allow Satan whatever free rein is necessary to bring to fulfillment all that the Bible has foretold will come to pass regarding the end of time.

In this issue of the magazine, we have once more endeavored to bring you information in the articles that is both helpful and relevant to our time in history. Brother Leonard Martin, a bishop in one of our churches has shared an exhortation on spiritual gifts in the church with a number of clear, practical observations for us today. The article that we have chosen to share from “Bible Helps” in this issue is one of the best discourses on the subject of “faith and works” that I have ever read. The writer even delves, with biblical simplicity and clarity, into the controversial subjects of divine election and predestination. Finally, we have The Foolishness of Preaching an evaluation regarding the basis of churches using “the altar call”—is it founded in the Scriptures and the history of the church or is it a method that the church has borrowed from the world in more recent years?!

All of this is sure to stir thoughts and discussion—which is our goal with these types of articles. Please feel free to respond via email or regular mail with your thoughts of caution or encouragement. This is helpful for us and our writers. When you write, we also ask that you mention yes or no if we can use your questions or comments in our magazine. We have had various requests to establish a section in our magazine dedicated to hearing from our readers.

One final thought… over the years our readers have, at times, shared with us ways that they think we could improve our magazine for the good of all who read it and to present a more clear gospel message. We welcome this to continue.

May God richly bless each of you,

Curvin L. Wenger

Χαιρέτισμα αδελφικής αγάπης σε όλους. Το έτος 2022 σχεδόν τελείωσε. Έχουν συμβεί πολλά. Άλλη μια χρονιά καταστροφικών καταιγίδων, πλημμυρών, πυρκαγιών, σεισμών, πολέμων και φημών περί πολέμων. Η Αμερική πέρασε άλλη μια περίοδο πολιτικών εκλογών, προκαλώντας ακόμη μεγαλύτερη πόλωση μεταξύ συντηρητικών και φιλελεύθερων σε αντίπαλα κόμματα.

Πρόσφατα, σκέφτομαι την παρούσα κατάσταση της ζωής ως δεσμευμένος Χριστιανός που πιστεύει τη Βίβλο στον κόσμο μας σήμερα. Βεβαίως, υπάρχουν μέρη στον κόσμο όπου οι Χριστιανοί ζουν υπό συνεχή απειλή φυλάκισης ή θανάτου απλώς επειδή προσπαθούν να ζήσουν σύμφωνα με τον Λόγο του Θεού. Ωστόσο, ο κόσμος φαίνεται να κινείται προς μια όλο και πιο αρνητική στάση απέναντι στον λαό του Θεού. Σε μια αναπτυσσόμενη τάση, υπάρχει μια εκπληκτική αύξηση της εχθρότητας προς τον δεσμευμένο πιστό.

Τι συμβαίνει; Είχα πολυάριθμες συνομιλίες με διάφορους πιστούς απ’ όλη τη χώρα που φαίνεται να έχουν μια αυξανόμενη ανησυχία για τη νυν νικηφόρα πορεία του κακού πάνω στο καλό, των φιλελεύθερων ατζεντών πάνω στον συντηρητικό τρόπο ζωής, και η λίστα συνεχίζεται. Η σημερινή ραγδαία αύξηση του πληθωρισμού, η πιθανότητα πρωτοφανούς κόστους θέρμανσης για πολλούς, οι φήμες για αύξηση των επιτοκίων και η συνεχής έλλειψη αγαθών συχνά τείνουν να ξαφνιάζουν τον άνθρωπο και να τον βγάζουν από την αίσθηση της κανονικότητας.

Για εμάς ως Χριστιανούς, ας διατηρούμε πάντα την προσοχή μας στραμμένη στον Θεό του ουρανού. Αυτός είναι ο Θεός που ο Παύλος κήρυξε στον Άρειο Πάγο —«ὁ ποιήσας τὸν κόσμον καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτῷ, οὐκ ἐστὶν ἐν ναοῖς χειροποιήτοις κατοικῶν· καὶ οὐκ ἐν χερσὶν ἀνθρώπων προσκυνούμενος, ὡς χρείαν ἔχων· ὅτι αὐτὸς δίδωσιν παντὶ ζωὴν καὶ πνοὴν καὶ πάντα» – Πράξεις 17:24-25.

Ας πάψουμε να εστιάζουμε στο ότι το κακό φαίνεται να υπερισχύει και να αυξάνεται γύρω μας και να συμπεραίνουμε πως κάπως ο Σατανάς έχει το πάνω χέρι τώρα. Αντιθέτως, ας υπενθυμίσουμε τι λέει ο Λόγος του Θεού. «Οἱ δὲ κακοὶ καὶ ἀπατηλοὶ πλεῖον ἔσονται πρὸς χεῖρον, πλανῶντες καὶ πλανώμενοι· σύνεχε δὲ ἐν ταῖς διδαχαῖς αἷς ἐμάθας καὶ ἥτις σε ἐβεβαίωσεν, εἰδώς ἀφʼ οὗ ἐμάθας· καὶ ἅπαξ ἀπὸ παιδὸς ἔγνωκας τὰ ἱερὰ γράμματα, τὰ δύναμα σε σοφίσαι εἰς σωτηρίαν διὰ τῆς πίστεως τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ· πᾶσα γραφὴ θεόπνευστος καὶ ὠφέλιμος πρὸς διδασκαλίαν, πρὸς ἔλεγχον, πρὸς ἐπανόρθωσιν, πρὸς παιδείαν τῆς δικαιοσύνης, ἵνα ἄνθρωπος θεοῦ ᾖ τέλειος, πρὸς πᾶν ἔργον ἀγαθὸν ἐξηρτισμένος» – 2 Τιμόθεο 3:13-17.

Ας διατηρούμε τα μάτια μας στραμμένα στον Ιησού «…τον ἀρχηγὸν καὶ τελειωτὴν τῆς πίστεώς ἡμῶν, ὃς ἀντὶ τῆς εὐφροσύνης τῆς προκειμένης ὑπέμεινεν τὸν σταυρὸν, ἐνκαυχώμενος τῆς αἰσχύνης, καὶ ἐκάθισεν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ θρόνου τοῦ Θεοῦ» – Εβραίους 12:2. Αντί να πιστεύουμε το ψέμα του Σατανά ότι κατά κάποιον τρόπο κερδίζει τώρα τη μάχη για την Αλήθεια, ας θυμηθούμε ότι η Βίβλος αποκαλύπτει πως ο Σατανάς δεν μπορεί να κάνει τίποτε χωρίς ο Θεός να του επιτρέπει προσωρινά ελευθερία δράσης. Φαινόταν σε αυτούς που παρακολουθούσαν ότι ο Σατανάς είχε απόλυτο προβάδισμα όταν ο Ιησούς σταυρώθηκε και ετάφη. Έκπληξη, έκπληξη! Ο Σατανάς άθελά του επέτρεψε στον Θεό να τον χρησιμοποιήσει για να εκπληρώσει όλα όσα είχαν προφητευτεί στις Γραφές. Το ίδιο συμβαίνει και σήμερα… ο Θεός θα επιτρέψει ξανά στον Σατανά όση ελευθερία δράσης χρειάζεται για να εκπληρωθεί όλα όσα η Βίβλος έχει προαναγγείλει ότι θα συμβούν σχετικά με το τέλος του κόσμου.

Σε αυτό το τεύχος του περιοδικού, προσπαθήσαμε για άλλη μια φορά να σας φέρουμε άρθρα που είναι τόσο χρήσιμα όσο και σχετικά με την εποχή μας στην ιστορία. Ο αδελφός Λέοναρντ Μάρτιν, επίσκοπος σε μια από τις εκκλησίες μας, μοιράζεται μια παρακίνηση για τα πνευματικά χαρίσματα στην εκκλησία με αρκετές σαφείς, πρακτικές παρατηρήσεις για εμάς σήμερα. Το άρθρο που επιλέξαμε να μοιραστούμε από τα «Βοηθήματα Βίβλου» σε αυτό το τεύχος είναι ένας από τους καλύτερους λόγους για το θέμα «πίστη και έργα» που έχω ποτέ διαβάσει. Ο συγγραφέας εμβαθύνει ακόμη, με βιβλική απλότητα και σαφήνεια, σε ταραχώδη θέματα όπως η θεία εκλογή και η εσχατολογική προκαθοριστικότητα. Τέλος, έχουμε «Η ανοησία του κηρύγματος»—μια αξιολόγηση σχετικά με τη βάση της χρήσης του «κάλεσματος στο βήμα» από τις εκκλησίες—είναι θεμελιωμένο στις Γραφές και στην ιστορία της εκκλησίας ή μήπως είναι μια μέθοδος που η εκκλησία έχει δανειστεί από τον κόσμο τα τελευταία χρόνια;

Όλα αυτά σίγουρα θα προκαλέσουν σκέψεις και συζήτηση—που είναι ο στόχος μας με αυτού του είδους τα άρθρα. Μη διστάσετε να απαντήσετε μέσω ηλεκτρονικού ή ταχυδρομικού ταχυδρομείου με τις σκέψεις σας, είτε προειδοποιήσεις είτε ενθαρρύνσεις. Αυτό είναι χρήσιμο για εμάς και τους συγγραφείς μας. Όταν γράφετε, σας ζητούμε επίσης να αναφέρετε ναι ή όχι αν μπορούμε να χρησιμοποιήσουμε τις ερωτήσεις ή τα σχόλιά σας στο περιοδικό μας. Έχουμε λάβει διάφορα αιτήματα να δημιουργήσουμε μια ενότητα στο περιοδικό μας αφιερωμένη στο να ακούμε τους αναγνώστες μας.

Μια τελική σκέψη… με τα χρόνια οι αναγνώστες μας, κάποιες φορές, μοιράστηκαν μαζί μας τρόπους που θεωρούν ότι θα μπορούσαμε να βελτιώσουμε το περιοδικό προς όφελος όλων όσων το διαβάζουν και για να παρουσιάσουμε ένα πιο σαφές μήνυμα του ευαγγελίου. Καλωσορίζουμε τη συνέχισή αυτού.

Είθε ο Θεός να ευλογεί πλούσια τον καθένα από εσάς,

Curvin L. Wenger
